programme.title: Travel Waes: De Bucketlist / Reizen Waes: de bucketlist
programme.desc: Tom goes to Taiwan, a country that risks sooner or later to be absorbed by China. Perhaps before Taiwan disappears forever, Tom almost to get to know the Asian island. And that brings him to some very strange places. For example, Tom meets a group of Taiwanese who lift heavy weights with their genitals and visits a life -threatening fireworks festival. / Tom trekt naar Taiwan, een land dat riskeert vroeg of laat opgeslorpt te worden door China. Voor Taiwan misschien voorgoed verdwijnt, haast Tom zich om het Aziatische eiland alsnog te leren kennen. En dat brengt hem op enkele heel vreemde plekken. Zo ontmoet Tom een groep Taiwanezen die zware gewichten tillen met hun geslachtsdelen en bezoekt hij een levensgevaarlijk vuurwerkfestival.

programme.title: Interview with the history / Interview met de geschiedenis
programme.desc: Arnout meets Marie Curie in Veurne, the moment the First World War has erupted in all its intensity. In a hasty front hospital, she tries, together with her daughter Irène, to save wounded soldiers with a revolutionary technique: radiology. A hundred years later, Arnout meets the diary of one of her patients and the story gets an unexpected turn. / Arnout ontmoet Marie Curie in Veurne, op het moment dat de Eerste Wereldoorlog in alle hevigheid is losgebarsten. In een haastig ingericht fronthospitaal probeert ze, samen met haar dochter Irène, gewonde soldaten te redden met een revolutionaire techniek: radiologie. Honderd jaar later stuit Arnout op het dagboek van een van haar patiënten en krijgt het verhaal een onverwachte wending.

programme.title: #IkLome / #LIKEME
programme.desc: A few weeks have passed and Caro has slowly but surely found the way at her new school. Yemi and Kyona have become two good friends, but there is something that Caro still withholds for everyone, namely that her mom is seriously ill. On the basis of her poetry assignment for the Dutch lesson, she tries to inform her class of the situation at home. Unfortunately, her poem is not taken seriously by everyone and Caro is running it. / Een aantal weken zijn verstreken en Caro heeft langzaam maar zeker de weg op haar nieuwe school gevonden. Yemi en Kyona zijn twee goeie vrienden geworden, maar er is iets dat Caro desondanks nog steeds voor iedereen achterhoudt, nl. dat haar mama ernstig ziek is. Aan de hand van haar poëzieopdracht voor de les Nederlands probeert ze haar klas op de hoogte te brengen van de situatie thuis. Helaas wordt haar gedicht niet door iedereen serieus genomen en zet Caro het op een lopen.

programme.title: The Hoppers / De Hoppers
programme.desc: When Arno has spent unsolicited money from his dad, he is punished by Jackie and Geert. To avoid his sentence, he sets up his own country: Arnoland. There he does not have to follow the rules of the hoppers and can do his way. Daria thinks it is a stupid idea until she discovers the benefits. This way they can watch their favorite horror series and eat as many chips as they want. Jackie is determined not to just let Arno and Daria get away with this. / Wanneer Arno weer eens ongevraagd geld van zijn pa heeft uitgegeven, wordt hij gestraft door Jackie en Geert. Om zijn straf te ontlopen, richt hij zijn eigen land op: Arnoland. Daar hoeft hij de regels van de Hoppers niet te volgen en kan hij zijn zin doen. Daria vindt het een stom idee, tot ze de voordelen ontdekt. Zo kunnen ze naar hun favoriete horrorreeks kijken en zoveel chips eten als ze maar willen. programme.desc: The new format, the author's travel-recorted journalist Biljana Stokic, discovery what the heart of the people tells about the Serbian, the tradition and history of our cities and villages, their everyday life and the struggle for preserving true values, diligent work, faith, and love for theirs and ours, Otamb. programme.desc: The six -part documentary series exploring the history of the cult, globally significant role of the Pope, one of the most respected and most beloved figures. One world leader .. with military, political and religious power remains wrapped in a veil of secrets, despite the unimaginable influence through the history and use of his power to design the flow of world history. Svaka od šest epizoda ispituje ključni historijski trenutak, u promjenjivoj dinamici ove iznimno snažne uloge i istražuje kako su papa i crkva zauzeli položaj koji danas imaju. Jedan svjetski vođa.. s vojnom, političkom i vjerskom moći ostaje obavijen velom tajne, uprkos nezamislivom utjecaju kroz historiju i korištenju svoje moći da bi oblikovao tok svjetske historije. programme.desc: The six -part documentary series exploring the history of the cult, globally significant role of the Pope, one of the most respected and most beloved figures. Svaka od šest epizoda ispituje ključni historijski trenutak, u promjenjivoj dinamici ove iznimno snažne uloge i istražuje kako su papa i crkva zauzeli položaj koji danas imaju. Jedan svjetski vođa.. s vojnom, političkom i vjerskom moći ostaje obavijen velom tajne, uprkos nezamislivom utjecaju kroz historiju i korištenju svoje moći da bi oblikovao tok svjetske historije. Zahvaljujući pristupu vatikanskim arhivima i ekskluzivnim intervjuima s nekima od najistaknutijih vjerskih vođa i teologa, serija istražuje kako je 12 apostola preraslo u današnjih 1,2 milijarde katolika.

programme.title: The promise / La Promesa
programme.desc: La Proses - (S04, E14, featured series, Spain, 2024) In 1913, while Europe is ruled by unrest, life on the noble estate of LA Promeda owned by the Luján family cannot be more peaceful - at least it seems. The family is preparing to celebrate one of the most important events in Spanish surplus society - the wedding of Tomás, the eldest son of Count Luján and the daughter of one of the most comfortable families in the country. However, the Luján family knows that this is a contracted marriage that the family should save from financial ruin. In the meantime, the enigmatic young Jana (20) begins to work on LA Promethew and helps as a maid during preparation for a wedding. As he wanders the building, he meets Manuel (23) the Counts of the youngest son and Tomás's half -brother. It is a meeting that will not be able to forget ... The Countess on the day of the wedding cannot hide her dissatisfaction since she wanted the groom to actually be her son Manuel. Her dissatisfaction is growing increasing, and after her outburst of anger, Jana gets fired. During the wedding, everything goes according to plan until Manuel performs a play with his plane double and shows incredible acrobatic skills, and the celebration is interrupted when he loses control and collapses not far from the property. Jana saw what happened and hurried to the scene to save Manuel. The Count offered Jani a generous award in gratitude, but she only asked to return her to work. The family does not know this, but Jana has a plan to avenge her mother who happened 15 years ago and wants to find her younger brother, who has been abducted the same evening. The only trail that Jana has to lead is to the magnificent building of La Provece, which he wants to infiltrate and find a murderer ... but also find love in Manuel's embrace. The next day another unfortunate event brings confusion to the property. Tomás was found dead. Sergeant Conrado, a member of the Civil Guard, is determined in his plan to find the killer. All evidence is referred to Jan because she is the last person with whom Tomás talked before his death. R .: Miguel Conda ... / La promesa - (S04, E14, igrana serija, Španjolska, 2024) Godine 1913., dok Europom vladaju nemiri, život na plemićkom imanju La Promesa u vlasništvu obitelji Luján ne može biti mirniji - bar se tako čini. Obitelj se priprema za proslavu jednog od najvažnijih događaja u španjolskom viskom društvu - vjenčanje Tomása, najstarijeg sina grofa Lujána i kćeri jedne od najimućnijih obitelji u zemlji. Međutim, obitelj Luján zna kako je ovo ugovoreni brak koji bi obitelj trebao spasiti od financijske propasti. U međuvremenu, zagonetna mlada Jana (20) počinje raditi na La Promesi te kao sluškinja pomaže tijekom priprema za vjenčanje. Dok luta zdanjem, susreće Manuela (23) grofova najmlađeg sina i Tomásova polubrata. Susret je to koji neće moći zaboraviti... Grofica na dan vjenčanja ne može skriti svoje nezadovoljstvo budući da je ona htjela da mladoženja zapravo bude njezin sin Manuel. Njezino nezadovoljstvo sve više raste, a nakon njezina ispada bijesa, Jana dobiva otkaz. Tijekom vjenčanja sve ide po planu sve dok Manuel ne izvede predstavu sa svojim avionom dvokrilcem te pokaže nevjerojatne akrobatske vještine, a slavlje se prekida kad izgubi kontrolu i sruši se nedaleko od imanja. Jana je vidjela što se dogodilo te pohita na mjesto nesreće kako bi spasila Manuela. Grof ponudi Jani velikodušnu nagradu u znak zahvalnosti, ali ona zatraži samo da je vrate na posao. Obitelj to ne zna, ali Jana cijelo vrijeme ima plan osvetiti ubojstvo svoje majke koje se dogodilo prije 15 godina te želi pronaći svog mlađeg brata koji je iste večeri otet. Jedini trag koji Jana ima vodi je do velebnog zdanja La Promesa u koje se želi infiltrirati te pronaći ubojicu... Ali i naći ljubav u Manuelovom zagrljaju. Idućeg dana još jedan nesretni događaj unese pomutnju na imanje. Tomás je pronađen mrtav. Narednik Conrado, pripadnik civilne garde, odlučan je u svom naumu da pronađe ubojicu. Svi dokazi upućuju na Janu jer ona je posljednja osoba s kojom je Tomás prije smrti razgovarao. R.: Miguel Cond...

programme.title: Gardener / Vrtlarica
programme.desc: Gardener - (S04, E06, Nature. Film, Croatia, 2023) For all those who feel nature as part of their lives, for those who enjoy the beauty of green plants and flowers, for those who have introduced gardening into their everyday life, there is a garden. Starting from the position of nature protection and its own health, the author of Kornelija Benyovsky Šoštarić, in addition to the already well -known stories of organic growing vegetables, fruits and flowers, also explores new areas related to horticulture and the green plant world. It reveals breeders that are plants and passion and life, beautifully shaped gardens, but also ways in which plants we can prepare, process and use in everyday life. The base and origin of these studies is the author's garden located on the Zagorje side of the hillside of Medvednica. He is a place of permanent experts with plants, but also a meeting place with interesting guests who transmit their own experiences about breeding or using plants. However, the author goes on, traveling around Croatia and meets interesting places and people who have tied their lives to the cultivation of some unusual species. For all those who want to really relax and enjoy the content that will provide inspiration and many useful ideas, Sunday afternoon will be reserved for the gardener from now on. R.: Nino Šoštarić ... / Vrtlarica - (S04, E06, prirod. film, Hrvatska, 2023) Za sve one koji prirodu osjećaju kao dio svog života, za one koji uživaju u ljepoti zelenih biljaka i cvijeća, za one koji su vrtlarstvo uveli u svoju svakodnevicu, tu je emisija Vrtlarica. Polazeći s pozicije zaštite prirode i vlastitog zdravlja, autorica Kornelija Benyovsky Šoštarić, uz već poznate priče o organskom uzgoju povrća, voća i cvijeća, istražuje i nova područja vezana uz hortikulturu i zeleni biljni svijet. Otkriva uzgajivače kojima su biljke i strast i život, predivno oblikovane vrtove, ali i načine na koje biljke možemo pripremiti, preraditi i koristiti u svakodnevnom životu. Baza i ishodište tih istraživanja je autoričin vrt smješten na zagorskoj strani obronaka Medvednice. On je mjesto stalnih eksperimanata s biljakama, ali i mjesto susreta sa zanimljivim gostima koji prenose vlastita iskustva o uzgoju ili korištenju biljaka. No, autorica polazi i dalje, putuje po Hrvatskoj i upoznaje zanimljiva mjesta i ljude koji su svoj život vezali uz uzgoj neke neobične vrste. Za sve one koji se žele doista opustiti i uživati u sadržaju koji će pružiti inspiraciju i mnoštvo korisnih ideja, nedjelja poslijepodne bit će od sada rezervirana za Vrtlaricu. R.: Nino Šoštarić...

programme.title: The promise / La Promesa
programme.desc: La Proses - (S04, E15, feature series, Spain, 2024) In 1913, while Europe is ruled by unrest, life on the noble property of LA Promess owned by the Luján family cannot be more peaceful - at least it seems. The family is preparing to celebrate one of the most important events in Spanish surplus society - the wedding of Tomás, the eldest son of Count Luján and the daughter of one of the most comfortable families in the country. However, the Luján family knows that this is a contracted marriage that the family should save from financial ruin. In the meantime, the enigmatic young Jana (20) begins to work on LA Promethew and helps as a maid during preparation for a wedding. As he wanders the building, he meets Manuel (23) the Counts of the youngest son and Tomás's half -brother. It is a meeting that will not be able to forget ... The Countess on the day of the wedding cannot hide her dissatisfaction since she wanted the groom to actually be her son Manuel. Her dissatisfaction is growing increasing, and after her outburst of anger, Jana gets fired. During the wedding, everything goes according to plan until Manuel performs a play with his plane double and shows incredible acrobatic skills, and the celebration is interrupted when he loses control and collapses not far from the property. Jana saw what happened and hurried to the scene to save Manuel. The Count offered Jani a generous award in gratitude, but she only asked to return her to work. The family does not know this, but Jana has a plan to avenge her mother who happened 15 years ago and wants to find her younger brother, who has been abducted the same evening. The only trail that Jana has to lead is to the magnificent building of La Provece, which he wants to infiltrate and find a murderer ... but also find love in Manuel's embrace. The next day another unfortunate event brings confusion to the property. Tomás was found dead. Sergeant Conrado, a member of the Civil Guard, is determined in his plan to find the killer. programme.title: Truth and lies / Istina i laži
programme.desc: TRUTH AND LIES - (E02, Educational Program, England, 2023) History of humanity is the history of truth and lies. Since ancient times until today, people have used lies to achieve economic, political and personal goals. This battle is run by pencil, keyboard and camera, but also weapons, torture and terror. And continues to relate countless victims. Because, who knows how to use the latest technologies most often can also gain interpretative sovereignty over what the truth is. The six -part documentary series shows that lies have been written history from an international perspective. Through various themes, it illuminates the role of the media in a merciless struggle for the truth. Truth and fabrication are nowhere as close as in religion. Secular interests are carried out under the guise of faith. In the war, lies justify bloodshed and conceal their own motives. Conspiracy theories are used for the outrage of the enemy and the creation of a grandmother. Money plays a special role because it often decides which truth will overcome. When the lies of powerful float to the light of day, scandals are created that not only stir up society, but can also become an incentive for social changes. But there will always be influential, powerful people who shape public opinions and who try to spread their own truth with all means ... / Truth and Lies - (E02, obrazovni program, Engleska, 2023) Povijest čovječanstva povijest je i borbe istine i laži. Od davnina sve do danas ljudi su se služili lažima kako bi postigli ekonomske, političke i osobne ciljeve. Ta se bitka vodi olovkom, tipkovnicom i kamerom, ali i oružjem, mučenjem i terorom. I nastavlja odnositi bezbrojne žrtve. Jer, onaj tko zna kako se najvještije koristiti najnovijim tehnologijama, može steći i interpretativni suverenitet nad onim što istina jest. Šestodijelna dokumentarna serija prikazuje kako se lažima pisala povijest iz međunarodne perspektive. Kroz različite teme osvjetljava ulogu medija u bespoštednoj borbi za istinu. Istina i izmišljotina nigdje nisu tako bliske kao u religiji. Svjetovni se interesi provode pod krinkom vjere. U ratu se lažima opravdava krvoproliće i prikrivaju vlastiti motivi. Teorije urote rabe se za ocrnjivanje neprijatelja i stvaranje babaroge. Novac ima posebnu ulogu jer često odlučuje koja će istina prevladati. Kada laži moćnih isplivaju na svjetlo dana, nastaju skandali koji ne samo da uzburkaju društvo, već mogu postati i poticaj za društvene promjene. No uvijek će biti utjecajnih, moćnih ljudi koji oblikuju javna mišljenja i koji pokušavaju širiti vlastitu istinu svim sredstvima...

programme.title: Gardener / Vrtlarica
programme.desc: Gardener - (S04, E06, Nature. Film, Croatia, 2023) For all those who feel nature as part of their lives, for those who enjoy the beauty of green plants and flowers, for those who have introduced gardening into their everyday life, there is a garden. Starting from the position of nature protection and its own health, the author of Kornelija Benyovsky Šoštarić, in addition to the already well -known stories of organic growing vegetables, fruits and flowers, also explores new areas related to horticulture and the green plant world. It reveals breeders that are plants and passion and life, beautifully shaped gardens, but also ways in which plants we can prepare, process and use in everyday life. The base and origin of these studies is the author's garden located on the Zagorje side of the hillside of Medvednica. He is a place of permanent experts with plants, but also a meeting place with interesting guests who transmit their own experiences about breeding or using plants. However, the author goes on, traveling around Croatia and meets interesting places and people who have tied their lives to the cultivation of some unusual species. Polazeći s pozicije zaštite prirode i vlastitog zdravlja, autorica Kornelija Benyovsky Šoštarić, uz već poznate priče o organskom uzgoju povrća, voća i cvijeća, istražuje i nova područja vezana uz hortikulturu i zeleni biljni svijet. Otkriva uzgajivače kojima su biljke i strast i život, predivno oblikovane vrtove, ali i načine na koje biljke možemo pripremiti, preraditi i koristiti u svakodnevnom životu. Baza i ishodište tih istraživanja je autoričin vrt smješten na zagorskoj strani obronaka Medvednice. On je mjesto stalnih eksperimanata s biljakama, ali i mjesto susreta sa zanimljivim gostima koji prenose vlastita iskustva o uzgoju ili korištenju biljaka. No, autorica polazi i dalje, putuje po Hrvatskoj i upoznaje zanimljiva mjesta i ljude koji su svoj život vezali uz uzgoj neke neobične vrste. Za sve one koji se žele doista opustiti i uživati u sadržaju koji će pružiti inspiraciju i mnoštvo korisnih ideja, nedjelja poslijepodne bit će od sada rezervirana za Vrtlaricu. R.: Nino Šoštarić...

U Osnovnoj školi Gustava Krkleca grafiti entuzijastkinja Antonija Bačić drži radionicu za učenike prvog razreda. Kako je za očekivati, prvašići su oduševljeni. programme.title: 67. Split Summer / 67. Splitsko ljeto
programme.desc: Split Summer - (Entertainment Program, Croatia) We bring the performance of the opera one -inch "Cavleria Rustica" ("Rural Knight"), Italian composer Pietra Mascagni, with the 67th Split Summer 2021. Verge, who was known for the realistic representations of life from his native Sicily. This first veristics opened Verdi himself, and even today, 130 years after his performance, he continues to delight the audience around the world. At the time of Mascagni's death in 1945, only 14,000 times were performed in Italy. The action of this popular opera was located in the 19th century, in a small Sicilian place on Easter morning. Powerful music and a dramatic plot of the shop grew from the hot Sicilian temperament speaks of love, jealousy, unbelief, longing, hypocrisy and fatal revenge. The choir and orchestra of the Croatian National Theater Split. Ivo Lipanovic, winner of the "Judita" award in the music program of the 66th of Split Summer, and is directed by Jelena Bosancic. The title roles are interpreted by: Santuzza, Kristina Kolar, Sopran, Lola, Antonia Teskera, MezzoSoSoprano, Turidda, Max Jotta, Tenor, Alfio, Paolo Gavanelli, Bariton, Lucia, Stefany Findrik, ALT. R .: Tvrtko Grgić ... / Splitsko ljeto - (zabavni program, Hrvatska) Donosimo izvedbu operne jednočinke "Cavalleria rusticana" ("Seosko viteštvo"), talijanskog skladatelja Pietra Mascagnija, sa 67. Splitskog ljeta 2021. Libretisti su Giovanni Targioni - Tozzetti i Guido Menasci, a kao osnova poslužio im je istoimeni kratki roman pisca Giovannija Verge koji je bio poznat po realističnim prikazima života iz rodne mu Sicilije. Ova prva veristička opera oduševila je i samog Verdija, a i danas, 130 godina nakon praizvedbe, nastavlja oduševljavati publiku diljem svijeta. U vrijeme Mascagnijeve smrti 1945. godine samo u Italiji je bila izvedena 14.000 puta. Radnja ove popularne opere smještena je u 19. stoljeću, u malom sicilijanskom mjestu na uskršnje jutro. Moćna glazba te dramatičan zaplet radnje izrastao iz vrelog sicilijanskog temperamenta govori o ljubavi, ljubomori, nevjeri, čežnji, licemjerju i fatalnoj osveti. Zborom i orkestrom HNK Split ravna mo. Ivo Lipanović, dobitnik nagrade "Judita" u glazbenom programu 66. Splitskog ljeta, a režiju potpisuje Jelena Bosančić. Naslovne uloge tumače: SANTUZZA, Kristina Kolar, sopran, LOLA, Antonija Teskera, mezzosopran, TURIDDU, Max Jotta, tenor, ALFIO, Paolo Gavanelli, bariton, LUCIA, Stefany Findrik, alt. programme.title: On the edge / Na rubu
programme.desc: On the edge - (Doc. Film, Croatia, 2010) on the edge of the city, in Zagreb's Dubrava, more and more young people are starting to train at the Leonardo boxing club, led by world -renowned Leonard Petraj coach. Although Petraj trained many champions, he opened the door of his club and the "problematic kids" with whom he works for free, but only on one condition - that they respect the rules of conduct that he imposed on them. The Boxing Teacher from Dubrava Leonard Petraj is a very unusual character in his environment, who does not see the rudeness in boxing, but a refined technique for the spiritual struggle with himself and becoming a better man. On the other side of the building where the boxing club is located is a folk cuisine that comes on the edge of existence every day, those who have lost their life battle. Some of them currently "lick the wounds" and collect strength for a new struggle, while others believe that the battle for them is permanently lost. In addition to boxers and homeless people, the third segment of the film are "Dubrave poets", the founders of the "Dirty Theater" group Davorin Bogović and Jasenko Houra. When the popular dirts were in the same years as Petra's young boxers, they composed songs on the theme of life everyday life of Dubrava, impressively recording the social picture of the workers' and immigrants on the edge of the city. The texts of their early songs are still as current today as it used to be. Today, some other kids live in Dubrava, but with always the same problems and hopes for a better tomorrow. The same streets pass some new people, preoccupied with always the same, old worries, desires and dreams. The story of the movie "On the Edge" includes an intimate confession of the protagonist and their daily life struggle in combination with music and stage comments, which makes it a kind of "documentary musical" recorded in black and white. R.: Tomislav Žaja ... / Na rubu - (dok. film, Hrvatska, 2010) Na rubu grada, u zagrebačkoj Dubravi, sve više mladih počinje trenirati u boksačkom klubu "Leonardo", koji vodi svjetski poznati trener Leonard Pijetraj. Iako je Pijetraj trenirao mnoge šampione, on je otvorio vrata svoga kluba i "problematičnim klincima" s kojima radi besplatno, ali samo pod jednim uvjetom - da poštuju pravila ponašanja koja im je nametnuo. Učitelj boksa iz Dubrave Leonard Pijetraj je nadasve neobičan lik u svome okruženju, koji u boksu ne vidi grubost, već istančanu tehniku za duhovnu borbu sa samim sobom i postajanje boljim čovjekom. S druge strane zgrade u kojoj je smješten boksački klub nalazi se pučka kuhinja u koju svakodnevno dolaze ljudi na rubu egzistencije, oni koji su životnu bitku izgubili. Neki od njih trenutno "ližu rane" i prikupljaju snagu za novu borbu, dok drugi smatraju da je bitka za njih trajno izgubljena. Uz boksače i beskućnike, treći segment filma su "pjesnici Dubrave", osnivači grupe "Prljavo kazalište" Davorin Bogović i Jasenko Houra. Kad su popularni Prljavci bili istih godina kao Pijetrajevi mladi boksači, skladali su pjesme na temu životne svakodnevice Dubrave, dojmljivo zabilježivši socijalnu sliku radničke i doseljeničke četvrti na rubu grada. Tekstovi njihovih ranih pjesama i danas su jednako aktualni kao nekada. Danas u Dubravi žive neki drugi klinci, ali s uvijek istim problemima i nadama u bolje sutra. Istim ulicama prolaze neki novi ljudi, zaokupljeni uvijek istim, starim brigama, željama i snovima. Priča filma "Na rubu" obuhvaća intimne ispovijesti protagonista i njihovu svakodnevnu životnu borbu u kombinaciji s glazbeno-scenskim komentarima, što ga čini svojevrsnim "dokumentarnim mjuziklom" snimljenim u crno-bijeloj tehnici. R.: Tomislav Žaja...

programme.title: On the edge of science / Na rubu znanosti
programme.desc: On the edge of science - (known. Pop. Series, Croatia) sound as therapy? Although not widespread, the idea is not new, nor does the practice. But what happens when the kinesiology and sound-vibration therapy get touched? What are today's knowledge of sound therapies? The sound, as it passes the body, has been shown to act on numerous factors, from the autonomic nervous system to the variability of the heart rhythm. It is well reminded of traditional forms of sound therapy as well as finding out modern aspects of sound therapy that is just developing and becomes a blend of tradition and modern science ... / Na rubu znanosti - (znan. pop. serija, Hrvatska) Zvuk kao terapija? Mada nije raširena, ideja nije nova, a niti praksa. No, što se događa kad se dotaknu kineziologija i zvučno-vibracijska terapija? Kakve su današnje spoznaje o zvučnim terapijama? Pokazalo se da zvuk, dok prolazi tijelom, djeluje na mnogobrojne faktore, od autonomnog živčanog sustava do varijabilnosti srčanog ritma. Dobro se podsjetiti i tradicionalnih oblika zvučne terapije kao i saznati moderne aspekte zvučne terapije koja se tek razvija i postaje spoj tradicije i moderne znanosti...

programme.title: Istrian frescoes / Istarske freske
programme.desc: Istrian frescoes - (Artistic Program, Croatia, 2017) Vesna Juric Rukavina's documentary, made with the help and support of the Diocese of Poreč and Pula, offers today's view of the past of one space and the fullness of life in it. The documentary is shown by a special Croatian gem at one time and creativity, which is much more than the painting of the space intended for the transfer of the Christian faith and the messages from the Old Testament and the New Testament. The scenes were shot in churches in Bale, God's Field, Vižinadi, Berm, Batvaca, Dvigrad, Kanfanar, Lovran, Hum, Roc, Draguć, Oprtalja, Lindar, Vodnjan, Poreč, Pula, Vol. Lovreč, Svetvincenat, Klostar above the sheet metal, Žminj and Peroj. In Istria, there are approximately 140 sites on which frescoes are located, from large and lavish to individual scenes and small fragments. The first frescoes in Istria were painted at the turn of 8th in the 9th century, while the golden age of the portrayal of sacral objects began in the 11th century and lasts until the 16th century. Indicators in the film are archaeologists and art historian Marino Baldini, conservator and art historian Željko Bistrovic, theologian and liturgical Milan Dancuo, archeologist and museologist Kristina Dzin, theologian Msgr. Marijan Jelinic, archaeologist Darko Komšo, art historian Sunčica Mustać and a licensed tourist guide for fresco Nikola Špehar. R .: Ivica Dlesk ... / Istarske freske - (umjetnički program, Hrvatska, 2017) Dokumentarni film Vesne Jurić Rukavine, snimljen uz pomoć i potporu Porečke i pulske biskupije, kroz dvadesetak crkava pruža današnji pogled u prošlost jednoga prostora i puninu života u njemu. Dokumentarni film prikazuje poseban hrvatski dragulj jednoga vremena i stvaralaštva, koji je mnogo više od samoga oslikavanja prostora namijenjena prenošenju kršćanske vjere i poruka iz Staroga zavjeta i Novoga zavjeta. Prizori su snimljeni u crkvama u Balama, Božjemu polju, Vižinadi, Bermu, Batvačima, Dvigradu, Kanfanaru, Lovranu, Humu, Roču, Draguću, Oprtlju, Lindaru, Vodnjanu, Poreču, Puli, Sv. Lovreču, Svetvinčentu, Kloštru iznad Lima, Žminju i Peroju. U Istri postoji približno 140 lokaliteta na kojima se nalaze freske, od velikih i raskošnih do pojedinačnih scena i sitnih fragmenata. Prve freske u Istri naslikane su na prijelazu 8. u 9. stoljeće, dok zlatno doba oslikavanja sakralnih objekata počinje u 11. stoljeću i traje sve do 16. stoljeća. Kazivači u filmu su arheolog i povjesničar umjetnosti Marino Baldini, konzervator i povjesničar umjetnosti Željko Bistrović, teolog i liturgičar Milan Dančuo, arheologinja i muzeologinja Kristina Džin, teolog mons. Marijan Jelinić, arheolog Darko Komšo, povjesničarka umjetnosti Sunčica Mustać te licencirani turistički vodič za freske Nikola Špehar. R.: Ivica Dlesk...

programme.desc: Šibenik - 950 years - (Doc. Through the turbulent history of Šibenik, the viewers are conducted by the narrator, the Šibenik actor Mate Gulin, and fifty costumed extras were hired for the recording purposes. In 50 minutes, the history of the city is summed up through small paintings from city life and its most prominent residents. The cadres for the film were filmed at different locations of the city and its surroundings, at the Museum of the City of Šibenik, in Šibenik's fortresses, at the Cathedral of St. Jacob, and the film covers all the relevant life areas in which the people of Sibenik have left a mark over the centuries, such as science and art, urbanism, music and sports. The movie "Sibenik - 950 years" is a film account of the identity of Kresimir's city, in which many people from Sibenik's public life participate. Zapravo još uvijek postoji toliko oružja, strategija, prilagodbi u podmorju kakve čovjek teško da može ponoviti svojim izumima. Ipak u tom "ratu" uvijek je postojala ravnoteža. Do pojave čovjeka. Our guest is Robert Perisic. Kristina Gavran was born in Zagreb and at the last year of dramaturgy studies gets an Erasmus scholarship and goes to professional practice in Birmingham. And now for ten years he has lived and worked in England and the life of a young married couple in that country is the theme of her new novel between ... / Knjiga ili život - (umjetnički program, Hrvatska) Danas kada se susrećemo sa stalno novim migrantima, Robert Perišić podsjetio nas je da je i naša civilizacija posljedica nekih davnih migracija. Naš je gost Robert Perišić. Kristina Gavran rođena je u Zagrebu a na posljednjoj godini studija dramaturgije dobiva Erasmus stipendiju i odlazi na stručnu praksu u Birmingham. programme.title: The world of classics / Svijet klasike
programme.desc: Classic World - (Music. A show, Croatia) Shakespeare's classic Romeo and Juliet, like his Hamlet, is an eternal inspiration to many diverse artistic reflections. Thus, the great opera composer Vincenzo Bellini wrote an opera in whose focus he put a conflict between two Veron families and called Capuleta and Montecchi. His opera version of Shakespeare's drama is rarely found on the repertoire because there are no known arias and is very difficult to perform, but this masterpiece is still full of wonderful topics and choral scenes. Therefore, it deserves to be enjoyed by the audience of our time, especially in Split, as a rule, a reluctant early Belkant. On the trail of extension of repertoire views, the title was placed in the program of the season of the Croatian National Theater there by the director of Split Opera Ivan Srbljan. For the conductor of reprise performances and assistant Maestro Ivo Lipanovic, who was preparing the premiere, she chose the best placed Croatian competitor at the conductor of the conductor of Lovro von Matacic, the choir of the Kojdija City Theater, Davor Kelic. The directorial job entrusted to the young and increasingly promising Hrvoje Korbar, to whom this is the second independent opera directing after last year Gotovac's one -piece Stanac in Zagreb. His closest associates are in this production of sculptor and set designer Zdravko Ivandi Kirigin, and painter and costume designer Barbara Bourek who opted for abstract design of historical sources. The crew of the class of classics arrives in Split at the last performance of the season, March 5, 2024, and deals with the compliant division consisting of domestic and guests: Split mezzo -soprano Bjanka Ivas (Romeo), Slovenian soprano Nina Dominko (Julija), Split Bariton Josko Tranfić (Lorenzo), Sinjski bass, Sam Furnes (Tebaldo). The small but powerful team gave her best to present this opera at the best. We recorded their thoughts on the subject ... / Svijet klasike - (glazb. emisija, Hrvatska) Shakespeareov klasik Romeo i Julija, poput njegova Hamleta, vječna je inspiracija mnogim raznolikim umjetničkim promišljanjima. Tako je veliki operni skladatelj Vincenzo Bellini napisao operu u čiji je fokus stavio sukob dviju veronskih obitelji, te djelo nazvao Capuleti i Montecchi. Njegova se operna verzija Shakespeareove drame rijetko nalazi na repertoaru jer nema poznatih arija i vrlo je teška za izvođenje, no ovo remek-djelo ipak vrvi predivnim temama i zborskim prizorima. Stoga u njemu zaslužuje uživati i publika našeg doba, poglavito u Splitu, u pravilu nesklonom ranom belkantu. Na tragu proširenja repertoarnih vidika naslov je u program sezone tamošnjega Hrvatskog narodnog kazališta smjestila ravnateljica Splitske opere Ivana Srbljan. Za dirigenta repriznih predstava i asistenta maestru Ivi Lipanoviću, koji je pripremao premijeru, odabrala je najbolje plasiranog hrvatskog natjecatelja na dirigentskom natjecanju Lovro von Matačić, inače zborovođu Gradskog kazališta Komedija, Davora Kelića. Redateljski je posao povjerila mladom i sve perspektivnijem Hrvoju Korbaru kojemu je ovo druga samostalna operna režija nakon prošloljetne Gotovčeve jednočinke Stanac u Zagrebu. Njegove su najbliskije suradnice u ovoj produkciji kiparica i scenografkinja Zdravka Ivandija Kirigin, te slikarica i kostimografkinja Barbara Bourek koje su se odlučile za apstraktno oblikovanje povijesnih izvora. Ekipa Svijeta klasike stiže u Split na posljednju predstavu u sezoni, 5. ožujka 2024., te zatiče usklađenu podjelu koju čine domaći i gosti: splitska mezzosopranistica Bjanka Ivas (Romeo), slovenska sopranistica Nina Dominko (Julija), splitski bariton Joško Tranfić (Lorenzo), sinjski bas Božo Župić (Capellio), te velški tenor Sam Furness (Tebaldo). Mala, ali moćna ekipa dala je sve od sebe predstaviti ovu operu u najboljem izdanju. Zabilježili smo njihova razmišljanja na tu temu...

programme.title: The world of jazz / Svijet jazza
programme.desc: Jazza World - (Music. A show, Croatia, 2024) What makes the life of jazz and jazzists specific in relation to other genres is the amount of importance to encounter new musicians, playing exchange with colleagues you have not had the opportunity to play with before. One such form was presented to us at the end of May 2024. Our Istrian jazz-shot: trumpeter Branko Sterpin, double bass player Vedran Ruzic and drummer Marco Quarantotto, joined by the fantastic Slovenian pianist Marko Crncec, all with the aim of hosting the Star of the World Jazz in Pula in Pula Zenona. The concert of this commemorative quintet, realized on Sterpin's initiative as part of the Jazz Waves program, was also important as an incentive for our musicians, who deserve to gain visibility through such collaborations. Zenon is at the moment in the special focus of the world of Jazz's world: he came to Pula shortly after receiving Grammy for Best Latin Jazz-Album, while in his career he was a scholarshipist of the Macarthur and Guggenheim Foundation, with many other awards. It is first and foremost a virtuoso instrumentalist and a stimulating composer, who offered our excellent musicians an unusual opportunity to expel from the comfort zone. Not unexpectedly, Sterpin, Ruzic, Quarantotto and Crncec showed that there is no lack of musicians in this region who have something to say to their world -class colleagues. All they have to do is give them the opportunity to share the stage with them, as offered to them in Pula - their undeniable talent, effort and willingness to musical exchanges will take care of everything else ... / Svijet jazza - (glazb. emisija, Hrvatska, 2024) Ono po čemu je život jazza i jazzista specifičan u odnosu na druge žanrove jest količina važnosti koja se pridaje susretu s novim glazbenicima, sviračkoj razmjeni s kolegama s kojima prethodno niste imali prilike zasvirati. Jedan takav oblik prikazale su nam potkraj svibnja 2024. naše istarske jazz-snage: trubač Branko Sterpin, kontrabasist Vedran Ružić i bubnjar Marco Quarantotto, kojima se pridružio fantastični slovenski pijanist Marko Črnčec, a sve s ciljem da u Puli ugoste zvijezdu svjetskog jazza, portorikanskog alt-saksofonista Miguela Zenona. Koncert tog prigodnog kvinteta, realiziran na Sterpinovu inicijativu u sklopu programa Jazz Waves, bio je važan već i kao poticaj našim glazbenicima, koji zaslužuju dobiti na vidljivosti kroz ovakve suradnje. Zenon je naime u ovom trenutku u posebnom fokusu svijeta jazza: u Pulu je došao nedugo nakon što je dobio Grammyja za najbolji latin jazz-album, dok je prethodno u karijeri bio stipendist zaklada MacArthur i Guggenheim, uz brojna druga priznanja. Riječ je prije svega o virtuoznom instrumentalistu i poticajnom kompozitoru, koji je našim izvrsnim glazbenicima ponudio nesvakidašnju priliku za izbacivanje iz zone komfora. Nimalo neočekivano, Sterpin, Ružić, Quarantotto i Črnčec pokazali su da na ovim prostorima ne nedostaje glazbenika koji imaju što reći svojim kolegama svjetskog glasa. Treba im samo dati priliku da s njima podijele pozornicu, kao što im je to ponuđeno u Puli - za sve ostalo će se pobrinuti njihov nesporan talent, trud i spremnost na glazbenu razmjenu...

programme.title: The world of classics / Svijet klasike
programme.desc: Classic World - (Music. A show, Croatia) Shakespeare's classic Romeo and Juliet, like his Hamlet, is an eternal inspiration to many diverse artistic reflections. Thus, the great opera composer Vincenzo Bellini wrote an opera in whose focus he put a conflict between two Veron families and called Capuleta and Montecchi. His opera version of Shakespeare's drama is rarely found on the repertoire because there are no known arias and is very difficult to perform, but this masterpiece is still full of wonderful topics and choral scenes. Therefore, it deserves to be enjoyed by the audience of our time, especially in Split, as a rule, a reluctant early Belkant. On the trail of extension of repertoire views, the title was placed in the program of the season of the Croatian National Theater there by the director of Split Opera Ivan Srbljan. For the conductor of reprise performances and assistant Maestro Ivo Lipanovic, who was preparing the premiere, she chose the best placed Croatian competitor at the conductor of the conductor of Lovro von Matacic, the choir of the Kojdija City Theater, Davor Kelic. The directorial job entrusted to the young and increasingly promising Hrvoje Korbar, to whom this is the second independent opera directing after last year Gotovac's one -piece Stanac in Zagreb. His closest associates are in this production of sculptor and set designer Zdravko Ivandi Kirigin, and painter and costume designer Barbara Bourek who opted for abstract design of historical sources. The crew of the class of classics arrives in Split at the last performance of the season, March 5, 2024, and deals with the compliant division consisting of domestic and guests: Split mezzo -soprano Bjanka Ivas (Romeo), Slovenian soprano Nina Dominko (Julija), Split Bariton Josko Tranfić (Lorenzo), Sinjski bass, Sam Furnes (Tebaldo). The small but powerful team gave her best to present this opera at the best. We recorded their thoughts on the subject ... / Svijet klasike - (glazb. emisija, Hrvatska) Shakespeareov klasik Romeo i Julija, poput njegova Hamleta, vječna je inspiracija mnogim raznolikim umjetničkim promišljanjima. Tako je veliki operni skladatelj Vincenzo Bellini napisao operu u čiji je fokus stavio sukob dviju veronskih obitelji, te djelo nazvao Capuleti i Montecchi. Njegova se operna verzija Shakespeareove drame rijetko nalazi na repertoaru jer nema poznatih arija i vrlo je teška za izvođenje, no ovo remek-djelo ipak vrvi predivnim temama i zborskim prizorima. Stoga u njemu zaslužuje uživati i publika našeg doba, poglavito u Splitu, u pravilu nesklonom ranom belkantu. Na tragu proširenja repertoarnih vidika naslov je u program sezone tamošnjega Hrvatskog narodnog kazališta smjestila ravnateljica Splitske opere Ivana Srbljan. Za dirigenta repriznih predstava i asistenta maestru Ivi Lipanoviću, koji je pripremao premijeru, odabrala je najbolje plasiranog hrvatskog natjecatelja na dirigentskom natjecanju Lovro von Matačić, inače zborovođu Gradskog kazališta Komedija, Davora Kelića. Redateljski je posao povjerila mladom i sve perspektivnijem Hrvoju Korbaru kojemu je ovo druga samostalna operna režija nakon prošloljetne Gotovčeve jednočinke Stanac u Zagrebu. Njegove su najbliskije suradnice u ovoj produkciji kiparica i scenografkinja Zdravka Ivandija Kirigin, te slikarica i kostimografkinja Barbara Bourek koje su se odlučile za apstraktno oblikovanje povijesnih izvora. Ekipa Svijeta klasike stiže u Split na posljednju predstavu u sezoni, 5. ožujka 2024., te zatiče usklađenu podjelu koju čine domaći i gosti: splitska mezzosopranistica Bjanka Ivas (Romeo), slovenska sopranistica Nina Dominko (Julija), splitski bariton Joško Tranfić (Lorenzo), sinjski bas Božo Župić (Capellio), te velški tenor Sam Furness (Tebaldo). Mala, ali moćna ekipa dala je sve od sebe predstaviti ovu operu u najboljem izdanju. Zabilježili smo njihova razmišljanja na tu temu...

programme.title: The world of jazz / Svijet jazza
programme.desc: Jazza World - (Music. A show, Croatia, 2024) What makes the life of jazz and jazzists specific in relation to other genres is the amount of importance to encounter new musicians, playing exchange with colleagues you have not had the opportunity to play with before. One such form was presented to us at the end of May 2024. Our Istrian jazz-shot: trumpeter Branko Sterpin, double bass player Vedran Ruzic and drummer Marco Quarantotto, joined by the fantastic Slovenian pianist Marko Crncec, all with the aim of hosting the Star of the World Jazz in Pula in Pula Zenona. The concert of this commemorative quintet, realized on Sterpin's initiative as part of the Jazz Waves program, was also important as an incentive for our musicians, who deserve to gain visibility through such collaborations. Zenon is at the moment in the special focus of the world of Jazz's world: he came to Pula shortly after receiving Grammy for Best Latin Jazz-Album, while in his career he was a scholarshipist of the Macarthur and Guggenheim Foundation, with many other awards. It is first and foremost a virtuoso instrumentalist and a stimulating composer, who offered our excellent musicians an unusual opportunity to expel from the comfort zone. Not unexpectedly, Sterpin, Ruzic, Quarantotto and Crncec showed that there is no lack of musicians in this region who have something to say to their world -class colleagues. All they have to do is give them the opportunity to share the stage with them, as offered to them in Pula - their undeniable talent, effort and willingness to musical exchanges will take care of everything else ... / Svijet jazza - (glazb. emisija, Hrvatska, 2024) Ono po čemu je život jazza i jazzista specifičan u odnosu na druge žanrove jest količina važnosti koja se pridaje susretu s novim glazbenicima, sviračkoj razmjeni s kolegama s kojima prethodno niste imali prilike zasvirati. Jedan takav oblik prikazale su nam potkraj svibnja 2024. naše istarske jazz-snage: trubač Branko Sterpin, kontrabasist Vedran Ružić i bubnjar Marco Quarantotto, kojima se pridružio fantastični slovenski pijanist Marko Črnčec, a sve s ciljem da u Puli ugoste zvijezdu svjetskog jazza, portorikanskog alt-saksofonista Miguela Zenona. Koncert tog prigodnog kvinteta, realiziran na Sterpinovu inicijativu u sklopu programa Jazz Waves, bio je važan već i kao poticaj našim glazbenicima, koji zaslužuju dobiti na vidljivosti kroz ovakve suradnje. Zenon je naime u ovom trenutku u posebnom fokusu svijeta jazza: u Pulu je došao nedugo nakon što je dobio Grammyja za najbolji latin jazz-album, dok je prethodno u karijeri bio stipendist zaklada MacArthur i Guggenheim, uz brojna druga priznanja. Riječ je prije svega o virtuoznom instrumentalistu i poticajnom kompozitoru, koji je našim izvrsnim glazbenicima ponudio nesvakidašnju priliku za izbacivanje iz zone komfora. Nimalo neočekivano, Sterpin, Ružić, Quarantotto i Črnčec pokazali su da na ovim prostorima ne nedostaje glazbenika koji imaju što reći svojim kolegama svjetskog glasa. Treba im samo dati priliku da s njima podijele pozornicu, kao što im je to ponuđeno u Puli - za sve ostalo će se pobrinuti njihov nesporan talent, trud i spremnost na glazbenu razmjenu...

programme.title: A book or life / Knjiga ili život
programme.desc: Book or Life - (Artistic Program, Croatia) Today, when we meet with constant new migrants, Robert Perisic reminded us that our civilization is also a consequence of some of the ancient migration. The novel The Issu ship brought us back to the 4th century before our era, in an era where the Illyrians did not want to drink wine brought by the Greeks, as an act of a kind of resistance to the then globalization, while the Greeks of beer considered Barbari. Our guest is Robert Perisic. Kristina Gavran was born in Zagreb and at the last year of dramaturgy studies gets an Erasmus scholarship and goes to professional practice in Birmingham. And now for ten years he has lived and worked in England and the life of a young married couple in that country is the theme of her new novel between ... / Knjiga ili život - (umjetnički program, Hrvatska) Danas kada se susrećemo sa stalno novim migrantima, Robert Perišić podsjetio nas je da je i naša civilizacija posljedica nekih davnih migracija. Roman Brod za Issu vraća nas u 4. stoljeće prije naše ere, u doba u kojem Iliri nisu htjeli piti vino koje su donijeli Grci, kao čin svojevrsnog otpora tadašnjoj globalizaciji, dok su pak Grci pivopije smatrali barbarima. Naš je gost Robert Perišić. Kristina Gavran rođena je u Zagrebu a na posljednjoj godini studija dramaturgije dobiva Erasmus stipendiju i odlazi na stručnu praksu u Birmingham. I sada već desetak godina živi i radi u Engleskoj a život mladog bračnog para u toj zemlji tema je njezinog novog romana Između...

How to monitor the growing up of nephews by recording his psychological states and resistance to educational methods? Is it hiding behind a "family exercise" a humorous departure from everyday routine or exploring new relationships within the family? To these questions, Petra is a slim answer - photos. Born in 1985 in Rijeka, she graduated in sociology and psychology, and then a photo at the Academy of Dramatic Arts in Zagreb. Krije li se iza "Vježbanja obitelji" humoristični odmak od svakodnevne rutine ili istraživanje novih odnosa unutar obitelji? Na ta pitanja Petra Mrša odgovora - fotografijama. Rođena 1985. u Rijeci, diplomirala je sociologiju i psihologiju, a nakon toga fotografiju na Akademiji dramske umjetnosti u Zagrebu. Fotografija joj postaje medij za psihološka i sociološka istraživanja koja je zaokupljaju. Osim fotografijom, ustaljene koncepte u suvremenom društvu ona propituje i kolažem, eksperimentalnim videom, instalacijom i performansom...

programme.title: Croatian submarine / Hrvatsko podmorje
programme.desc: Croatian submarine - (S05, E06, known. Pop. Series, Croatia, 2003) Thousands of islands, cliffs, reefs sprouting from the sea in a flipping aircraft seem so as retreat. But each is a special world. Sometimes a little harder available, but still a space that harder to keep its secrets. Even the sea that connects them loses the veil of mysticism before the performance of a growing and more advanced technology. The last oasis of the unknown, the latest secret chambers of the Adriatic are sought in the submerged boses of the stone coast. In the flooded caves - mystical and horrific beauties. They still live a imagination that created ancient deity, mythical monsters, legends. But they guard those and the living world still unknown. Various species are revealed with each new cave. Not just caves of secret chambers. The night in the submarine always discovers a new animal. We still do not have technology for daily walking in big depths. Until we do this, the sea and depth will be the last big secret chamber on the planet. R.: Miro Andrić ... / Hrvatsko podmorje - (S05, E06, znan. pop. serija, Hrvatska, 2003) Tisuće otoka, hridi, grebena što izviruju iz mora u preletu zrakoplovom čine se tako dohvatljivima. No svaki je poseban svijet. Nekada malo teže dostupan, ali ipak prostor koji sve teže čuva svoje tajne. Čak i more koje ih povezuje gubi veo mističnosti pred nastupom sve raširenije i naprednije tehnologije. Zadnje oaze nepoznatoga, zadnje tajne odaje Jadrana tražimo u potopljenim njedrima kamene obale. U potopljenim špiljama - mističnim i stravičnim ljepoticama. U njima još uvijek živi mašta koja je stvarala prastara božanstva, mitska čudovišta, legende. Ali čuvaju one i živi svijet još uvijek nepoznat. Razne vrste otkrivaju se sa svakom novom špiljom. Nisu samo špilje tajne odaje. Noć u podmorju uvijek otkrije neku novu životinjicu. Još uvijek nemamo tehnologiju za svakodnevno šetanje velikim dubinama. Dok to ne ostvarimo, more i dubine bit će zadnja velika tajna odaja na planetu. R.: Miro Andrić...

Ova animirana serija namijenjena je predškolskom uzrastu, a simpatični Vrtuljići, baš kao i djeca tog uzrasta, kroz zabavu uče osnovne pojmove kao što su ispod i iznad, gore i dolje, pun i prazan i sl. Kako su Vrtuljići često nespretni, u novom svijetu o kojem djeca znaju više od njih, njihovi će pokušaji i pogreške djecu nasmijati, a kroz zabavu će i sama (ili tijekom gledanja serije uz roditelje i starije) ponešto i naučiti...

programme.title: We discover Croatia / Otkrivamo Hrvatsku
programme.desc: We discover Croatia - (Doc. Series, Croatia, 2025) just 300 meters from the mainland, from Brodarica near Šibenik, located Krapanj, the lowest and smallest populated island on the Adriatic. The island of the centuries -old tradition of diving, sponge and fisheries. This tradition has been preserved to this day, but not nearly in that ratio of how it used to be when each house had its own ship and equipment. There used to be about 1,500 people living on Krapanj, and today there are only about 150 permanent residents. There are many more in the emigration. In Melbourne alone, for example, there are about 1000 descendants of Krapljan. But there are also those who return to their roots today from the various sides of the world. The Krapljani continues to tirelessly strive to preserve their heritage and convey it to those who continue on - "... for the world, to know what we have and what we are doing as we are ..." R .: Tatjana Rau ... / Otkrivamo Hrvatsku - (dok. serija, Hrvatska, 2025) Svega 300 metara od kopna, od Brodarice kod Šibenika, smjestio se Krapanj, najniži i najmanji naseljeni otok na Jadranu. Otok višestoljetne tradicije ronilaštva, spužvarstva i ribarstva. Ta se tradicija očuvala do danas, no ni približno u onome omjeru kako je to nekad bilo, kad je svaka kuća imala svoj brod i opremu. Nekad je na Krapnju živjelo oko 1.500 ljudi, a danas je tek oko 150 stalnih stanovnika. Puno više ima ih u iseljeništvu. Samo u Melbourneu, primjerice, živi oko 1000 potomaka Krapljana. No, ima i onih koji se svojim korijenima i danas vraćaju s raznih strana svijeta. Krapljani se i dalje neumorno trude očuvati svoju baštinu i prenijeti je onima koji nastavljaju dalje - "...za svijet, da se zna što imamo i što nas čini takvima kakvi jesmo..." - kaže Roko Tanfara iz poznate obitelji krapljanskih ronilaca i spužvara. R.: Tatjana Rau...

There are many news, from the latest methods in regenerative medicine, news in rheumatology and orthopedia, capillaroscopy, early detection of venous and arterial insufficiency, to the early rehabilitation of children and news in neurology, and with a mental aspect - about narcissis. Physical medicine and rehabilitation, subspec. rheumatologist ... / Studio 4: Dijagnoza - (show magazin, Hrvatska) Najavljujemo vrlo zanimljiv znanstveni skup - Medicinski forum 2025., koji će se održati u Zagrebu 5. rujna, isključivo za liječnike raznih područja i na temu integriranog pristupa medicini. Ima puno novosti, od najnovijih metoda u regenerativnoj medicini, novosti u reumatologiji i ortopediji, kapilaroskopiji, ranom otkrivanju venske i arterijske insuficijencije, do rane rehabilitacije djece i novosti u neurologiji, a s psihičkog aspekta - o narcisoidnosti. Gost emisije: Šime Mijić, dr. med., spec. fizikalne medicine i rehabilitacije, subspec. reumatolog...

For human rights in Strasbourg, on the election process for the president of the Supreme Court, how much did it help or fired from the law mile, about moral dilemmas in criminal cases, and the future of lawyer and judiciary in the context of an increasing effect of artificial intelligence. Fran Olujic was born in Zagreb on May 5, 1977 in the family of his mother's architect and father, a well -known lawyer and the first Attorney General. After graduating from the XVI, he enrolled in the Faculty of Law, at which he graduated in 2003. He passed the judicial exam in 2005, and in 2006 he was entered in the directory of the lawyer of the Croatian Bar Association. He is the owner of a law firm who deals with civil, trade law and employs a dozen lawyers and law trainees. In the last 15 years, there was almost no major and more important criminal case in which he had not been hired. The current judicial and social issues do not publicly comment on, and, thanks to Insijder, insight and professional knowledge, is a common and respected interlocutor in the media. He speaks English, German and Italian. He lives in Zagreb with his wife and three ... / Romano Bolković - 1 na 1 - (talk show, Hrvatska, 2025) S odvjetnikom Franom Olujićem razgovaramo o trenutačnom stanju hrvatskog pravosuđa i načinu na koji ga percipira šira javnost, o tome koliko smo udaljeni od ideala vladavine prava s obzirom da državu vode pravnici, je li činjenica da je profesor prava bio Predsjednik RH išta promijenila, o tome koji je najveći problem hrvatskog pravosuđa danas, ima li pomaka nabolje u našem pravosuđu, o problemima u obrazovanju budućih pravnika i njihovoj pripremi za praktičan rad, o korupciji i organiziranom kriminalu, zašto složeni sudski postupci u RH traju godinama, o curenju informacija iz istraga u javnost i medijskoj pripremi predmeta, o izravnom i neizravnom političkom utjecaju na sudove i Državno odvjetništvo, o radu glavnog državnog odvjetnika, o ulozi EPPO-a, Europskog suda pravde i Europskog suda za ljudska prava u Strasbourgu, o izbornom procesu za predsjednika Vrhovnog suda, koliko mu je je to što je iz odvjetničkog miljea pomoglo ili odmoglo, o moralnim dilemama u kaznenim predmetima te o budućnosti odvjetništva i pravosuđa u kontekstu sve većeg utjecaja umjetne inteligencije. Fran Olujić rođen je u Zagrebu 5. svibnja 1977. u obitelji majke arhitektice i oca, poznatog odvjetnika te prvog glavnog državnog odvjetnika. Nakon završetka XVI. jezične gimnazije upisuje Pravni fakultet, na kojem je diplomirao 2003. godine. Pravosudni ispit položio je 2005., a 2006. godine upisuje se u Imenik odvjetnika Hrvatske odvjetničke komore. Vlasnik je odvjetničkog društva koje se bavi građanskim, trgovačkim i kaznenim pravom te zapošljava desetak odvjetnika i odvjetničkih vježbenika. U posljednjih 15 godina gotovo da nije bilo većeg i važnijeg kaznenog predmeta u kojem nije bio angažiran. Ne libi se javno komentirati aktualna pravosudna i društvena pitanja te je, zahvaljujući insajderskom uvidu i stručnom znanju, čest i cijenjen sugovornik u medijima. Govori engleski, njemački i talijanski jezik. Živi u Zagrebu sa suprugom i tro...

programme.desc: Minority mosaic - (educational film, Croatia) danced once. They still dance today. They bridged all those good, but also lead years on Kordun, dance. This is above all and above all a school of life for many young people. The leader of the Cedomir Studen ensemble points out that the mission of the ensemble is to build healthy intermediate relationships. Dancing its own and dances from other parts, it enriches its own culture and builds a wider view of the world ... / Manjinski mozaik - (obrazovni film, Hrvatska) Plesali su nekad. Plešu i danas. Mnoge generacije mladih Srba, Hrvata i Bošnjaka s ponosom kažu da su prve korake naučili u Ansamblu narodnih igara i pjesama Vojnić. I nije to samo folklor. programme.title: Bahar / Bahar
programme.desc: The life of the housewife (Bahar), full of disappointments, becomes a new meaning when she returns from death, and it is decided to complete her dream that she abandoned, and to confront the society that he considered dead. / تصبح حياة ربة المنزل (بهار) المليئة بخيبات الأمل ذات معنى جديد حين تعود من الموت، وتُقرر استكمال حلمها الذي تخلت عنه، ومواجهة المجتمع الذي اعتبرها ميتة.

programme.title: My Name Is Farah S2 / My Name Is Farah S2
programme.desc: After a long hunt, (Benham) finally finds (Farah), and at the same time, (Taher) is released and faces many challenges, from an attempt to kill to attempts to discourage him from his plan for revenge. / بعد مطاردة طويلة، يعثر (بنهام) أخيرًا على (فرح)، وفي الوقت نفسه، يتم إطلاق سراح (طاهر) ويواجه العديد من التحديات، من محاولة قتل إلى محاولات إثنائه عن خطته للانتقام.

programme.title: Family Secrets / Family Secrets
programme.desc: The work is taking place in a dramatic framework, where a lawyer and prosecutor must work together to investigate a murder to find the killer, which creates an irreversible collapse in their lives. / يدور العمل في إطار درامي، حيث يتعين على محامي ومدعي العام العمل معًا بالتحقيق في جريمة قتل للعثور على القاتل، مما يخلق نقطة انهيار لا رجعة فيها في حياتهما.

programme.title: Customer / العميل
programme.desc: The story of the series revolves around the brothers Amir and Medal who are separated by destiny from a young age, Amir grows up to become a police officer, but he joins a gang as part of a secret operation. While his brother Wissam, who was kidnapped when he was a child, grows up to become part of the same gang. Without their knowledge, the brothers work together without knowing their reality, and their fate is intertwined in an exciting framework full of suspense. / تدور قصة المسلسل حول الأخوين أمير ووسام الذين يفرقهما القدر منذ الصغر، يكبر أمير ليصبح ضابط شرطة، لكنه ينضم لعصابة كجزء من عملية سرية. بينما أخوه وسام، الذي اختطف عندما كان طفلاً، يكبر ليصبح جزءً من نفس العصابة. بدون علمهما، يعمل الأخوان معًا دون معرفة حقيقتهما، ويتشابك مصيرهما في إطار مثير مليء بالتشويق.

programme.title: Arabz Jot Talent 6 / آرابز جوت تالنت 6

programme.title: My mom / أمي
programme.desc: Basma lives in a house that is shrouded in violence and neglect because of her mother's husband, Obaid, who suffers from a smile of ill -treatment and lack of safety, which makes her life full of fear and loneliness. Her teacher, Maryam, hinted silent signs of Basma's suffering, so she decided to intervene to save her from this difficult situation. Mary creates a strong relationship with Basma, and fights alongside her to free her from the circle of pain and violence, which makes a major shift in the child's life and gives her hope for a better future. / تعيش الطفلة بسمة في منزل يكتنفه العنف والإهمال بسبب زوج والدتها عبيد، تعاني بسمة من سوء المعاملة وقلة الأمان، مما يجعل حياتها مليئة بالخوف والوحدة. تلمح معلمتها مريم، علامات صامتة على معاناة بسمة، فتقرر التدخل لإنقاذها من هذا الوضع الصعب. تنشئ مريم علاقة قوية مع بسمة، وتكافح إلى جانبها لتحريرها من دائرة الألم والعنف، مما يحدث تحولًا كبيرًا في حياة الطفلة ويمنحها الأمل في مستقبل أفضل.

programme.title: Al -Zind: the sinner / الزند: ذئب العاصي
programme.desc: Asi's father is killed in front of his eyes in defense of his land, and when his return intensifies, he decides to take revenge for his father and revenge for him, and returns to his village after performing military service, and he finds himself in the face of Nawras Pasha and his strong influence and power. / يٌقتل والد عاصي أمام أعينه دفاعا عن أرضه، وعندما يشتد عوده يقرر الانتقام لوالده والثأر له، ويعود إلى قريته بعد تأديته الخدمة العسكرية، فيجد نفسه في مواجهة النورس باشا وما يملك من نفوذ وسلطة قوية.

programme.title: He married what Lea said / تزوج ما قالها ليا
programme.desc: In a framework of comic events, a fifty widow man is in strange and funny situations when his three daughters are known for his second wife, claiming to be her aunt who was living in Italy. / في إطار من الأحداث الكوميدية، يقع رجل خمسيني أرمل في مواقف غريبة ومضحكة عندما يعرف بناته الثلاثة على زوجته الثانية مدعيا أنها خالتهن التي كانت تعيش في إيطاليا.

programme.title: I was overwhelmed / إغلب السقا
programme.desc: The Entertainment Competitions Program, the Arabic version of the International Program (Beat the Star), where its idea depends on hosting a star of art to compete with the artist Ahmed El -Sakka, and the prizes go in the end in the form of donations for charities. / برنامج مسابقات ترفيهي، يعتبر النسخة العربية من البرنامج العالمي (Beat the Star)، حيث تعتمد فكرته على استضافة نجم من نجوم الفن ليتنافس مع الفنان أحمد السقا، وتذهب الجوائز في النهاية في صورة تبرعات للجمعيات الخيرية.

programme.title: Baghdad thief / لص بغداد
programme.desc: Hussein Al -Rawi (Ahmed Rizk), a historical researcher and author of books on the treasures buried in the land of Egypt, trying to cultivate the love of history in the hearts of his young children, Youssef and Khaled, but they did not respond to the lesson, and when they grew up, they professionalized the stealing of the Pharaonic tombs, and the universe of Joseph (Muhammad Imam) and Khaled (Fathi Abdel Wahab) is a gang to steal the antiquities ( Stolen. Nadia Yakov (Amina Khalil), a leader of an international gang to steal the antiquities, is from an Egyptian mother and a father of a Russian arms dealer, and she wanted to include the gang of Youssef and his brother Khaled for her gang, and Khaled agreed, and Joseph and Majdi refused. After a while, Nadia began searching for the cemetery of Alexander the Great, and Khaled separated from it, to work for his account, and when Joseph stole papers from the Nadia office, he also learned about the order of the cemetery, and that one of the keys to the cemetery, is present with the mask of Alexander in Kenya, so he traveled there with Majdi, and he was able to steal the mask, but Nadia men responded, and kidnapped him in a plane, he was able to jump from it, Discover that the key is not a mask, as Khaled preceded them, and got the key. Youssef found in Nadia's papers, a paper written in Latin, so he discussed in the history section of those who translated the paper, and met the historical researcher Salma Suleiman (Yasmine Rais), which is a doctorate about the Cemetery of Alexander the Great, and I told him that the latter in the year 336 BC, a dream of leading the world, and prepared his armies to invade the world, and when he failed to fulfill his dream, he collected all his treasures, and put it in a cemetery that opens with a cemetery The keys, each key indicates the next place of the key, and that the paper says that the second key, in the helmet of Alexander, located in one of the museums of Baghdad, and Joseph and Salma traveled with them Majdi to Iraq, where Joseph infiltrated the museum at night, and put something with the helmet that he could follow, so when Khaled stole it, Youssef managed to follow him, and obtained the first and second key. The third key was in the statue of an Indian elephant, which was stolen by the mafia man Adrian Khoussa, and he went to Madrid, and Nadia was able to reach Adrian, and agreed with him to hand her the statue, and his club managed to chase Youssef and arrest him, and his restriction next to Khaled, who had previously kidnapped him. Khaled managed to dismantle him, and he fled, leaving his brother bound, and managed to steal the statue with the third key, and Joseph also managed to dismantle him and escape, to meet with Majdi and Salma, who were late to save him. (Baghdad thief) / حسين الراوي (أحمد رزق) باحث تاريخي ومؤلف كتب عن الكنوز المدفونة فى أرض مصر، يحاول أن يزرع حب التاريخ فى نفوس أبناءه الصغار، يوسف وخالد، ولكنهما لم يستجيبا للدرس، وعندما كبروا، إحترفوا سرقة المقابر الفرعونية، وكون يوسف (محمد امام) وخالد (فتحي عبدالوهاب) تشكيل عصابي لسرقة الآثار، ويساعدهم مجدي (محمد عبدالرحمن) فى تصريف المسروقات. نادية ياكوف (أمينه خليل) زعيمة عصابة دولية لسرقة الآثار، وهى من أم مصرية وأب تاجر سلاح روسي، وقد رغبت فى ضم عصابة يوسف وأخيه خالد لعصابتها، ووافق خالد، ورفض يوسف ومجدي. وبعد فترة بدأت نادية فى البحث عن مقبرة الاسكندر الأكبر، وإنفصل عنها خالد، ليعمل لحسابه، ولما قام يوسف بسرقة أوراق من مكتب نادية، علم هو الآخر بأمر المقبرة، وأن أحد مفاتيح المقبرة، متواجد بقناع الاسكندر فى كينيا، فسافر الى هناك مع مجدي، وتمكن من سرقة القناع، ولكن رجال نادية طاردوه، وإختطفوه فى طائرة، تمكن من القفز منها، وقفزت وراءه نادية، ولكنهم إكتشفوا أن المفتاح ليس بالقناع، فقد سبقهم خالد، وحصل على المفتاح. عثر يوسف فى أوراق نادية، على ورقة مكتوبة باللاتينية، فبحث فى قسم التاريخ عمن يترجم له الورقة، وقابل الباحثة التاريخية سلمي سليمان (ياسمين رئيس) والتى تعد دكتوراه عن مقبرة الإسكندر الأكبر، وأخبرته أن الأخير فى عام ٣٣٦ قبل الميلاد، حلم بقيادة العالم، وجهز جيوشه لإجتياح العالم، وعندما فشل فى تحقيق حلمه، جمع كل كنوزه، ووضعها فى مقبرة تفتح بأربعة مفاتيح، كل مفتاح يشي بمكان المفتاح الذى يليه، وأن الورقة تقول أن المفتاح الثاني، فى خوذة الإسكندر، المتواجدة بأحد متاحف بغداد، وسافر يوسف وسلمي ومعهم مجدي للعراق، حيث تسلل يوسف للمتحف ليلاً، ووضع بالخوذة شيئ يمكنه من تعقبها، فلما سرقها خالد، تمكن يوسف من تعقبه، والحصول علي المفتاحين الأول والثاني. وكان المفتاح الثالث فى تمثال فيل هندي، سرقه رجل المافيا أدريان خوسية، وذهب به إلى مدريد، وإستطاعت نادية الوصول إلى أدريان، وإتفقت معه على تسليمها التمثال، وتمكنت ناديه من مطاردة يوسف والقبض عليه، وتقييده بجانب خالد، الذى سبق لها خطفه. تمكن خالد من فك قيده، وهرب تاركاً أخيه مقيداً، وتمكن من سرقة التمثال وبه المفتاح الثالث، وأيضاً تمكن يوسف من فك قيده والهرب، ليتقابل مع مجدي وسلمي، الذين تأخروا فى إنقاذه. ولأن المفتاح الرابع موجود فى درع الاسكندر، المتواجد بسفينة غارقة فى سواحل اليونان، فقد سافر الجميع إلى هناك، وتمكنت نادية وعصابتها من القبض على يوسف وسلمي، وحصلت منهم على المفتاحين الأول والثاني، ثم ألقتهم فى البحر مقيدين، ولكن يوسف تمكن من تحرير نفسه، ثم تحرير سلمي، وتغلب على رجال نادية، الذين غاصوا فى البحر، لإستخراج المفتاح الرابع، الذى تمكن يوسف من الحصول عليه. إجتمع اللصوص الثلاثة يوسف وخالد ونادية، وإتفقوا على العمل سوياً، وتوزيع الغنيمة بنسبة ما مع كل منهم من مفاتيح، نادية المفتاح الأول والثاني، وخالد المفتاح الثالث، ويوسف وسلمي المفتاح الرابع، وعلموا من الأوراق والمفاتيح أن المقبرة تقع بواحة سيوه، وتمكنوا من فتحها، وواجهوا الأفخاخ المتواجدة بها، ولقي خالد مصرعة فى إحداها، وواصلوا حتى عثروا على آلاف الأطنان من الذهب، وحاولت نادية التخلص من يوسف وسلمي، ولكن المقبرة تزلزلت، ولقت نادية مصرعها، ومعها أفراد عصابتها، وتمكن يوسف وسلمي، ومعهم مجدي، من مغادرة المقبرة سالمين، وتركوا أمرها للحكومة، وقرر الثلاثة ترك سرقة الآثار، ودراسة التاريخ، والبحث عن آثارنا المختبأة بباطن الأرض، ويكفيهم شرف إكتشافها، وتزوج يوسف من سلمي، وعثر مجدي على نصفه الآخر. (لص بغداد)

programme.title: Woh toh hai albelaa / Woh Toh Hai Albelaa
programme.desc: (Krishna) is a fun brother who loves his brother and always stands beside them, especially his older brother (Chero), who is doing his best to maintain his safety and protect him from any harm, then his life turns upside down when circumstances force him to marry Habiba (Chero). / (كريشنا) هو أخ مرح محب لشقيقيه ويقف بجانبهما دائمًا، وبالأخص شقيقه الأكبر (تشيرو) الذي يبذل قصارى جهده للحفاظ على سلامته وحمايته من أي مكروه، ثم تنقلب حياته رأسًا على عقب عندما تجبره الظروف على الزواج من حبيبة (تشيرو).

programme.title: My mom / أمي
programme.desc: Basma lives in a house that is shrouded in violence and neglect because of her mother's husband, Obaid, who suffers from a smile of ill -treatment and lack of safety, which makes her life full of fear and loneliness. Her teacher, Maryam, hinted silent signs of Basma's suffering, so she decided to intervene to save her from this difficult situation. Mary creates a strong relationship with Basma, and fights alongside her to free her from the circle of pain and violence, which makes a major shift in the child's life and gives her hope for a better future. / تعيش الطفلة بسمة في منزل يكتنفه العنف والإهمال بسبب زوج والدتها عبيد، تعاني بسمة من سوء المعاملة وقلة الأمان، مما يجعل حياتها مليئة بالخوف والوحدة. تلمح معلمتها مريم، علامات صامتة على معاناة بسمة، فتقرر التدخل لإنقاذها من هذا الوضع الصعب. تنشئ مريم علاقة قوية مع بسمة، وتكافح إلى جانبها لتحريرها من دائرة الألم والعنف، مما يحدث تحولًا كبيرًا في حياة الطفلة ويمنحها الأمل في مستقبل أفضل.

programme.title: Wild Heart S2 / Wild Heart S2
programme.desc: In the second season, after the meeting of all family members under one roof, (Yaman) reveals the real intentions (Sarhan), and faces a dangerous opponent, and he seeks to secure the future of his loved ones. / في الموسم الثاني وبعد اجتماع جميع أفراد العائلة تحت سقف واحد، يكشف (يامان) نوايا (سرحان) الحقيقية، ويواجه خصما خطيرا، فيسعى لتأمين مستقبل أحبائه.

programme.title: Birth certificate / شهادة ميلاد
programme.desc: A mother is struggling with various means to preserve her family from disintegration, after the death of the father, but facts from the distant past are revealed to fluctuate the scales and fail all plans, and warns of a fateful future. / تجاهد أم بشتى الوسائل للحفاظ على عائلتها من التفكك وذلك بعد وفاة الأب، لكن حقائق من الماضي البعيد تتكشف لتقلب الموازين وتفشل كل الخطط، وتنذر بمستقبل مشؤوم.

programme.title: Why not?! 3 / ليه لأ؟! 3
programme.desc: The events revolve around (Sherry), a divorced mother with a special relationship with her son (Yassin), but when she falls in love again, Yassin's jealousy forms an obstacle that they must overlook together. / تدور الأحداث حول (شيري)، وهي أم مطلقة تتمتع بعلاقة خاصة مع ابنها (ياسين)، ولكن عندما تقع في الحب من جديد، تشكل غيرة (ياسين) عليها عقبة يتوجب عليهما تجاوزها سويًا.

programme.title: My Name Is Farah / My Name Is Farah
programme.desc: Farah works illegally cleaning in Istanbul after escaping from Iran, then she tries to travel to France and take care of her young son, but her life turns upside down when she witnesses a murder in her workplace, then she tries to escape from the perpetrators of the crime after getting to know her. / تعمل (فرح) عاملة نظافة بشكل غير قانوني في إسطنبول بعد فرارها من إيران، ثم تحاول السفر إلى فرنسا والاعتناء بابنها الصغير، لكن تنقلب حياتها رأسًا على عقب عندما تشهد جريمة قتل في مكان عملها، ثم تحاول الهرب من مرتكبي الجريمة بعد تعرفهم عليها.

programme.title: middle age crisis / أزمة منتصف العمر
programme.desc: After Fayrouz marries Ezzat despite the great age difference between them, she falls in love with his daughter's husband - Omar - and their secret relationship causes many problems for her. / بعد أن تتزوج فيروز من عزت بالرغم من فارق السن الكبير بينهما، تقع في حب زوج ابنته- عمر - وتتسبب علاقتهما السرية بمشاكل كثيرة لها.

programme.desc: The ruling facilitates the illegal smuggling of its power and its many relationships by the corrupt policemen, despite his son, Ryan, the police officer who is tackling outlaws. / يقوم الحكم بتيسير عمليات التهريب الغير شرعية لسلطته وعلاقاته العديدة من قبل رجال الشرطة الفاسدين، على الرغم من ابنه ريان ضابط الشرطة الذي يقوم بالتصدي للخارجين عن القانون.

programme.title: Pariersii / Parineetii
programme.desc: The events take place in a dramatic framework, where fate leads two friends close to marriage to the same man, which leads to many difficulties with the emergence of a complex love triangle, and the events continue. / تدور الأحداث في إطار درامي، حيث يقود القدر صديقتين مقربتين للزواج من نفس الرجل، مما يؤدي إلى العديد من الصعوبات مع ظهور مثلث حب معقد، وتتوالى الأحداث.

programme.title: Nun Al -Niswa / نون النسوة
programme.desc: In a social dramatic framework, the events of the series gathered five friends, gathering the paths of life, and their problems and dreams spread, and each of them tries to support the other until they reach safety after a group of disappointments that struck them. / في إطار درامي اجتماعي تجمع أحداث المسلسل خمس صديقات، تجمعهن دروب الحياة، فيتشاركن مشاكلهن، وأحلامهن، وتحاول كلا منهن مساندة الأخرى حتى يصلن إلى بر الأمان بعد مجموعة خيبات ضربت بهن.

programme.title: Dunk / Dunk
programme.desc: The series revolves around a university, where the student Amal accuses her professor of harassing her, thus receiving support from all around her, but we discover that all of this is part of a plan that the student has orphaned to save her fiancé from great trouble. / تدور أحداث المسلسل في إحدى الجامعات، حيث تتهم الطالبة أمل أستاذها بالتحرش بها وبذلك تلقى الدعم من جميع من حولها، ولكن نكتشف أن كل هذا هو جزء من خطة قد دبرتها الطالبة لإنقاذ خطيبها من ورطة كبيرة.

programme.title: My dear father / والدي العزيز
programme.desc: A failed love story ends with the separation of a man and a woman and their departure from each other, but when they meet again after many years, this love story returns to open its doors again. / تنتهي قصة حب فاشلة بانفصال رجل وامرأة وابتعادهما عن بعضهما البعض، ولكن حينما يتقابلان من جديد بعد سنوات عديدة، تعود قصة الحب تلك لتفتح أبوابها من جديد.

programme.title: Wild Bees / Wild Bees

programme.title: Golden Boy / Golden Boy
programme.desc: The events take place in a dramatic framework, where (Hallis Agha), one of the pillars of the established families in the city of (Gaziantep), decides to marry his riotous grandson (Farid), then the events continue. / تدور الأحداث في إطار درامي، حيث يقرر (هاليس آغا)، وهو أحد أعمدة العائلات الراسخة في مدينة (غازي عنتاب)، تزويج حفيده المشاغب (فريد)، ثم تتوالى الأحداث.

programme.title: We have other sayings / لدينا أقوال أخرى
programme.desc: The events revolve around a previous legal advisor that causes an accident that leads to a young man, so the investigation of her in the case begins and the advisor is exposed to a number of problems due to this accident, until she is accused of another murder, then she is sentenced to death, and the events continue to prove her innocence. / تدور الأحداث حول مستشارة قانونية سابقة تتسبب في حادث يودي بحياة شاب، فيبدأ التحقيق معها في القضية وتتعرض المستشارة لعدد من المشاكل بسبب هذا الحادث، حتى يتم إتهامها بجريمة قتل أخرى، ثم يتم الحكم عليها بالإعدام، وتتوالى الأحداث في سبيل إثبات براءتها.

programme.title: Life today / Hayat Bugun
programme.desc: The chief physician (Paris Jovinner) is appointed at Haysarono Hospital, in Istanbul, where the hospital is going through a difficult time, where (Paris) is trying to restart the hospital, and is fighting a difficult battle for his patients and colleagues. / يُعين كبير الأطباء (باريس جوفينر) في مستشفى (هيسارونو)، في إسطنبول، حيث تمر المستشفى بوقت عصيب، حيث يحاول (باريس) إعادة تشغيل المستشفى، ويخوض معركة صعبة من أجل مرضاه وزملائه.

programme.title: Boxing Girls C1 / بنات الملاكمة ج1
programme.desc: The series tells the story of an ambitious young Saudi girl working to open a gym in Saudi Arabia, and begins training young Saudi women in boxing arts and secrets. / يروي المسلسل قصة فتاة شابة سعودية طموحة تعمل على افتتاح صالة ألعاب رياضية في السعودية، وتبدأ في تدريب النساء السعوديات الشابات على فنون الملاكمة وأسرارها.

programme.title: Beirut batch / دفعة بيروت
programme.desc: The events take place in the sixties of the last century, where a group of students travel to Beirut to study there at the university, and a number of exciting events are located. / تدور الأحداث في ستينيات القرن الماضي، حيث مجموعة من الطلاب يسافرون إلى بيروت ليدرسون هناك بالجامعة، وتقع لهم عدد من الأحداث المثيرة.في لبنان عام 1964، ويجد مجموعة منهم أنفسهم في دوامة من الأفكار والطموحات المتناقضة والعادات المختلفة... وفي شباك الحب.

programme.title: Raisinghani vs raisinghani / Raisinghani vs Raisinghani
programme.desc: In a dramatic framework, the skilled smart lawyer (Anushka) works with her ambitious colleague (Firat), but their lives change after the appearance of the trainee (Ankita) who hides her true intention and hides under the guise of the researcher for a job opportunity. / في إطار درامي، تعمل المحامية الذكية الماهرة (أنوشكا) مع زميلها الطموح (فيرات)، ولكن تتغير حياتهما بعد ظهور المتدربة (أنكيتا) التي تخفي نيتها الحقيقية وتتخفى تحت ستار الباحثة عن فرصة عمل.

programme.title: Mawlana, the lover / مولانا العاشق
programme.desc: The events revolve around a young man named (Sultan) who works as a microbus driver, lives in a popular neighborhood and has a love relationship with a girl in the same popular neighborhood, but she does not exchange a feeling and prefers a wealthy young man, after which he is subjected to a group of problems he and his cousin (Shehata). / تدور الأحداث حول شاب يدعى(سلطان) يعمل سائق ميكروباص، ويقيم بحي شعبي وتربطه علاقة حب مع بنت في نفس الحي الشعبي ولكنها لا تبادله الشعور وتفضل عليه شاب ثري، ليتعرض بعدها لمجموعة من المشكلات هو وابن عمه (شحتة).

programme.title: Price / الثمن
programme.desc: The widow Sarah resorted to her only remaining option to cover the costs of treating her son Ibrahim from cancer, so he agreed to spend one night with the company manager Zain for an amount of money. / تلجأ الأرملة سارة لخيارها الوحيد المتبقي لتغطية تكاليف علاج ابنها إبراهيم من السرطان، فتوافق على قضاء ليلة واحدة مع مدير الشركة زين مقابل مبلغ من المال.
