programme.title: Boxing Girls C1 / بنات الملاكمة ج1
programme.desc: The series tells the story of an ambitious young Saudi girl working to open a gym in Saudi Arabia, and begins training young Saudi women in boxing arts and secrets. / يروي المسلسل قصة فتاة شابة سعودية طموحة تعمل على افتتاح صالة ألعاب رياضية في السعودية، وتبدأ في تدريب النساء السعوديات الشابات على فنون الملاكمة وأسرارها.

programme.title: Life today / Hayat Bugun
programme.desc: The chief physician (Paris Jovinner) is appointed at Haysarono Hospital, in Istanbul, where the hospital is going through a difficult time, where (Paris) is trying to restart the hospital, and is fighting a difficult battle for his patients and colleagues. / يُعين كبير الأطباء (باريس جوفينر) في مستشفى (هيسارونو)، في إسطنبول، حيث تمر المستشفى بوقت عصيب، حيث يحاول (باريس) إعادة تشغيل المستشفى، ويخوض معركة صعبة من أجل مرضاه وزملائه.

programme.title: Beirut batch / دفعة بيروت
programme.desc: The events take place in the sixties of the last century, where a group of students travel to Beirut to study there at the university, and a number of exciting events are located. / تدور الأحداث في ستينيات القرن الماضي، حيث مجموعة من الطلاب يسافرون إلى بيروت ليدرسون هناك بالجامعة، وتقع لهم عدد من الأحداث المثيرة.في لبنان عام 1964، ويجد مجموعة منهم أنفسهم في دوامة من الأفكار والطموحات المتناقضة والعادات المختلفة... وفي شباك الحب.

programme.title: Raisinghani vs raisinghani / Raisinghani vs Raisinghani
programme.desc: In a dramatic framework, the skilled smart lawyer (Anushka) works with her ambitious colleague (Firat), but their lives change after the appearance of the trainee (Ankita) who hides her true intention and hides under the guise of the researcher for a job opportunity. / في إطار درامي، تعمل المحامية الذكية الماهرة (أنوشكا) مع زميلها الطموح (فيرات)، ولكن تتغير حياتهما بعد ظهور المتدربة (أنكيتا) التي تخفي نيتها الحقيقية وتتخفى تحت ستار الباحثة عن فرصة عمل.

programme.title: Mawlana, the lover / مولانا العاشق
programme.desc: The events revolve around a young man named (Sultan) who works as a microbus driver, lives in a popular neighborhood and has a love relationship with a girl in the same popular neighborhood, but she does not exchange a feeling and prefers a wealthy young man, after which he is subjected to a group of problems he and his cousin (Shehata). / تدور الأحداث حول شاب يدعى(سلطان) يعمل سائق ميكروباص، ويقيم بحي شعبي وتربطه علاقة حب مع بنت في نفس الحي الشعبي ولكنها لا تبادله الشعور وتفضل عليه شاب ثري، ليتعرض بعدها لمجموعة من المشكلات هو وابن عمه (شحتة).

programme.title: Price / الثمن
programme.desc: The widow Sarah resorted to her only remaining option to cover the costs of treating her son Ibrahim from cancer, so he agreed to spend one night with the company manager Zain for an amount of money. / تلجأ الأرملة سارة لخيارها الوحيد المتبقي لتغطية تكاليف علاج ابنها إبراهيم من السرطان، فتوافق على قضاء ليلة واحدة مع مدير الشركة زين مقابل مبلغ من المال.

programme.title: Under the seventh land / تحت سابع أرض
programme.desc: The officer (Moussa) takes advantage of his powers to achieve personal gains in corrupt and twisted ways, which makes him in a direct confrontation with the people who blackmail them, while discovering that his two brothers visit the dollars, and he finds himself in a difficult dilemma between leaving them to face the gangs alone, or managing this work himself to protect them. / يستغل الضابط (موسى) صلاحياته لتحقيق مكاسب شخصية بطرق فاسدة وملتوية، مما يجعله في مواجهة مباشرة مع الأشخاص الذين يبتزهم، بينما يكتشف أن أخويه يزوران الدولارات، فيجد نفسه في مأزق صعب بين تركهم لمواجهة العصابات بمفردهما، أو إدارة هذا العمل بنفسه لحمايتهما.

programme.title: Selma / سلمى
programme.desc: The series deals with the story of Salma, a young mother who faces life alone after her husband, Jalal, disappeared in mysterious circumstances. She finds herself obliged to raise her two children in poverty, shocks and loneliness, embodying her journey a deep humanitarian model of the suffering of Arab mothers who are steadfastly having life. / يتناول المسلسل قصة سلمى، وهي أم شابة تواجه الحياة بمفردها بعد اختفاء زوجها جلال في ظروف غامضة. تجد نفسها مضطرة لتربية طفليها وسط الفقر والصدمات والوحدة، فتجسد رحلتها نموذجًا إنسانيًا عميقًا لمعاناة الأمهات العربيات اللواتي يواجهن قسوة الحياة بثبات.

programme.title: Good morning, Arabs / صباح الخير يا عرب
programme.desc: A daily morning program, discussing the social problems of interest to the Arab citizen, which displays many paragraphs such as motherhood, health, beauty, art, travel, and community problems. / برنامج صباحي يومي، يقوم بمناقشة المشاكل الإجتماعية التي تهم المواطن العربي، يعرض الكثير من الفقرات كالأمومة، والصحة، والجمال، والفن، والسفر، ومشاكل المجتمع.

programme.title: Studio 21 / ستوديو 21
programme.desc: In a social comic framework that tells about a satellite channel on the verge of bankruptcy, its dominant, authoritarian owner decides to continue the work, resulting in the occurrence of many comic paradoxes between him and the channel's employees. / في إطار اجتماعي كوميدي يحكي العمل عن قناة فضائية على وشك الإفلاس، يقرر مالكها المحتال المتسلط مواصلة العمل، مما ينتج عنه حدوث العديد من المفارقات الكوميدية بينه وبين العاملين بالقناة.

programme.title: Esref Ruya / Esref Ruya
programme.desc: In a romantic framework, the rich and reckless businessman (Ashraf) is in love with (Revelation), who was looking for a person like his life, but what is ignorant of him is that she is working against him for the police. / في إطار رومانسي، يقع رجل الأعمال الثري والمتهور (أشرف) في حب (رؤيا) التي كان يبحث عن شخصية مثلها طوال حياته، لكن ما يجهله هو أنها تعمل ضده لدى الشرطة.

programme.title: Hakim Pasha / حكيم باشا
programme.desc: (Hakim) works to excavate the effects and their trade, then his uncle puts all the family’s property in his hand due to his intelligence and support for him in managing his business, and thus becomes great for the family and governs control of their affairs, but soon his enemies, and conspiracies surrounded by every direction, even from the closest relatives. / يعمل (حكيم) في التنقيب عن الآثار وتجارتها، ثم يضع عمه كل أملاك العائلة في يده نظرًا لذكائه ومساندته له في إدارة أعماله، ويصبح بذلك كبيرًا للعائلة ويُحكم السيطرة على أمورها، لكن سرعان ما يكثر أعداؤه، وتحيط به المؤامرات من كل اتجاه، حتى من أقرب الأقربين.

programme.title: My mom / أمي
programme.desc: Basma lives in a house that is shrouded in violence and neglect because of her mother's husband, Obaid, who suffers from a smile of ill -treatment and lack of safety, which makes her life full of fear and loneliness. Her teacher, Maryam, hinted silent signs of Basma's suffering, so she decided to intervene to save her from this difficult situation. Mary creates a strong relationship with Basma, and fights alongside her to free her from the circle of pain and violence, which makes a major shift in the child's life and gives her hope for a better future. / تعيش الطفلة بسمة في منزل يكتنفه العنف والإهمال بسبب زوج والدتها عبيد، تعاني بسمة من سوء المعاملة وقلة الأمان، مما يجعل حياتها مليئة بالخوف والوحدة. تلمح معلمتها مريم، علامات صامتة على معاناة بسمة، فتقرر التدخل لإنقاذها من هذا الوضع الصعب. تنشئ مريم علاقة قوية مع بسمة، وتكافح إلى جانبها لتحريرها من دائرة الألم والعنف، مما يحدث تحولًا كبيرًا في حياة الطفلة ويمنحها الأمل في مستقبل أفضل.

programme.title: MBC News / أخبار MBC
programme.desc: The newsletter of the MBC network, which works around the clock to cover all the news and events in various fields, with displaying its various details and developments from all angles. / نشرة الأخبار الخاصة بشبكة قنوات (MBC)، والتي تعمل على مدار الساعة لتغطية كافة الأخبار والأحداث في شتى المجالات، مع عرض تفاصيلها وتطوراتها المختلفة من كافة الزوايا.

programme.title: The sweetest of Tash / أحلى ما طاش
programme.desc: The program (Ahla Ma Tash) is returning a presentation of a group of the best episodes that were presented through the Saudi comedy series (Tash Ma Tash), which continued to be shown on Saudi TV for 18 continuous seasons, through which (Nasser Al -Qasabi) and (Abdullah Al -Sadhan) discussed a group of social issues that occupy the Saudi society in a sarcastic way. / يعيد برنامج (أحلى ما طاش) عرضا لمجموعة من أفضل الحلقات التي تم تقديمها من خلال المسلسل الكوميدي السعودي (طاش ما طاش)، والذي استمر عرضه على التليفزيون السعودي لمدة 18 موسمًا متواصلًا، والتي ناقش من خلالها (ناصر القصبي) و(عبدالله السدحان) مجموعة من القضايا الاجتماعية التي تشغل بال المجتمع السعودي بطريقة ساخرة.

programme.title: Program on Mona table / برنامج على طاولة منى
My mom / أمي
programme.desc: Basma lives in a house that is shrouded in violence and neglect because of her mother's husband, Obaid, who suffers from a smile of ill -treatment and lack of safety, which makes her life full of fear and loneliness. Her teacher, Maryam, hinted silent signs of Basma's suffering, so she decided to intervene to save her from this difficult situation. Mary creates a strong relationship with Basma, and fights alongside her to free her from the circle of pain and violence, which makes a major shift in the child's life and gives her hope for a better future. / تعيش الطفلة بسمة في منزل يكتنفه العنف والإهمال بسبب زوج والدتها عبيد، تعاني بسمة من سوء المعاملة وقلة الأمان، مما يجعل حياتها مليئة بالخوف والوحدة. تلمح معلمتها مريم، علامات صامتة على معاناة بسمة، فتقرر التدخل لإنقاذها من هذا الوضع الصعب. تنشئ مريم علاقة قوية مع بسمة، وتكافح إلى جانبها لتحريرها من دائرة الألم والعنف، مما يحدث تحولًا كبيرًا في حياة الطفلة ويمنحها الأمل في مستقبل أفضل.

programme.title: Esref Ruya / Esref Ruya
programme.desc: In a romantic framework, the rich and reckless businessman (Ashraf) is in love with (Revelation), who was looking for a person like his life, but what is ignorant of him is that she is working against him for the police. / في إطار رومانسي، يقع رجل الأعمال الثري والمتهور (أشرف) في حب (رؤيا) التي كان يبحث عن شخصية مثلها طوال حياته، لكن ما يجهله هو أنها تعمل ضده لدى الشرطة.

programme.title: Studio 21 / ستوديو 21
programme.desc: In a social comic framework that tells about a satellite channel on the verge of bankruptcy, its dominant, authoritarian owner decides to continue the work, resulting in the occurrence of many comic paradoxes between him and the channel's employees. / في إطار اجتماعي كوميدي يحكي العمل عن قناة فضائية على وشك الإفلاس، يقرر مالكها المحتال المتسلط مواصلة العمل، مما ينتج عنه حدوث العديد من المفارقات الكوميدية بينه وبين العاملين بالقناة.

programme.title: Under the seventh land / تحت سابع أرض
programme.desc: The officer (Moussa) takes advantage of his powers to achieve personal gains in corrupt and twisted ways, which makes him in a direct confrontation with the people who blackmail them, while discovering that his two brothers visit the dollars, and he finds himself in a difficult dilemma between leaving them to face the gangs alone, or managing this work himself to protect them. / يستغل الضابط (موسى) صلاحياته لتحقيق مكاسب شخصية بطرق فاسدة وملتوية، مما يجعله في مواجهة مباشرة مع الأشخاص الذين يبتزهم، بينما يكتشف أن أخويه يزوران الدولارات، فيجد نفسه في مأزق صعب بين تركهم لمواجهة العصابات بمفردهما، أو إدارة هذا العمل بنفسه لحمايتهما.

programme.title: Hakim Pasha / حكيم باشا
programme.desc: (Hakim) works to excavate the effects and their trade, then his uncle puts all the family’s property in his hand due to his intelligence and support for him in managing his business, and thus becomes great for the family and governs control of their affairs, but soon his enemies, and conspiracies surrounded by every direction, even from the closest relatives. / يعمل (حكيم) في التنقيب عن الآثار وتجارتها، ثم يضع عمه كل أملاك العائلة في يده نظرًا لذكائه ومساندته له في إدارة أعماله، ويصبح بذلك كبيرًا للعائلة ويُحكم السيطرة على أمورها، لكن سرعان ما يكثر أعداؤه، وتحيط به المؤامرات من كل اتجاه، حتى من أقرب الأقربين.

programme.title: Selma / سلمى
programme.desc: The series deals with the story of Salma, a young mother who faces life alone after her husband, Jalal, disappeared in mysterious circumstances. She finds herself obliged to raise her two children in poverty, shocks and loneliness, embodying her journey a deep humanitarian model for the suffering of Arab mothers who are steadfastly having life. / يتناول المسلسل قصة سلمى، وهي أم شابة تواجه الحياة بمفردها بعد اختفاء زوجها جلال في ظروف غامضة. تجد نفسها مضطرة لتربية طفليها وسط الفقر والصدمات والوحدة، فتجسد رحلتها نموذجًا إنسانيًا عميقًا لمعاناة الأمهات العربيات اللواتي يواجهن قسوة الحياة بثبات.

programme.title: Sweet people / الناس الحلوة
programme.desc: (Sweet People) program is a specialized medical program. The program hosts doctors to find out medical information and to respond to consultations. / برنامج (الناس الحلوة) هو برنامج طبي متخصص، يستضيف البرنامج أطباء لمعرفة معلومات طبية وللرد على الاستشارات.

programme.title: Coercion / زواج بالإكراه
programme.desc: (Laila) A wealthy young man who is exposed to a traffic accident, which is bleeding and needs a quick blood transfusion, coincides with the blood type of her blood type with her private driver's blood, he transports blood to her without knowing that he himself is sick with AIDS and the disease moves to her, the young woman's life turns into misery and waiting for death, and she loves a new young man in her father's company named (Ahmed), but he does not exchange love; Because he loves (Hind), which he is about to marry, her father (Saeed Al -Koumi) threatens him to kill his fiancée and relatives in order to force him to marry his sick daughter with AIDS, and the events continue. / (ليلى) شابّة ثرية تتعرَّض لحادثة مرورية تنزف إثرها وتحتاج إلى نقل دم سريع، يتصادف أن تتطابق فصيلة دمها مع فصيلة دم سائقها الخاص، ينقل لها دمًا منه دون أن يعلم أنه هو نفسه مريض بالإيدز وينتقل إليها المرض، تنقلب حياة الشابة إلى تعاسة وانتظار للموت، وتحب شابًّا جديدًا في شركة أبيها اسمه (أحمد)، لكنه لا يبادلها الحب؛ لأنه يحب (هند) التي هو على وشك الزواج بها، يقوم والدها (سعيد الكومي) بتهديده بقتل خطيبته وأقاربه حتى يجبره على الزواج من ابنته المريضة بالإيدز، وتتوالى الأحداث.

programme.title: Shade / ظل
programme.desc: Several strings are intertwined, as Qais leaves his work in the lawyer because he does not tolerate silence from injustice, at the same time, Jalal takes advantage of the law for his personal interests, and on the other side Gibran is the international fashion designer, he tries to overcome his crisis after his beloved Nawar committed suicide. / خيوط عدة تتشابك، حيث يترك قيس عمله في المحاماه لعدم تحمله السكوت عن الظلم، في الوقت ذاته يستغل جلال القانون من أجل مصالحه الشخصية، وعلى الجهة الأخرى يحاول جبران مصمم الأزياء العالمي تجاوز أزمته بعد انتحار حبيبته نواره.

programme.desc: (Laila) A wealthy young man who is exposed to a traffic accident, which is bleeding and needs a quick blood transfusion, coincides with the blood type of her blood type with her private driver's blood, he transports blood to her without knowing that he himself is sick with AIDS and the disease moves to her, the young woman's life turns into misery and waiting for death, and she loves a new young man in her father's company named (Ahmed), but he does not exchange love; Because he loves (Hind), which he is about to marry, her father (Saeed Al -Koumi) threatens him to kill his fiancée and relatives in order to force him to marry his sick daughter with AIDS, and the events continue. / (ليلى) شابّة ثرية تتعرَّض لحادثة مرورية تنزف إثرها وتحتاج إلى نقل دم سريع، يتصادف أن تتطابق فصيلة دمها مع فصيلة دم سائقها الخاص، ينقل لها دمًا منه دون أن يعلم أنه هو نفسه مريض بالإيدز وينتقل إليها المرض، تنقلب حياة الشابة إلى تعاسة وانتظار للموت، وتحب شابًّا جديدًا في شركة أبيها اسمه (أحمد)، لكنه لا يبادلها الحب؛ لأنه يحب (هند) التي هو على وشك الزواج بها، يقوم والدها (سعيد الكومي) بتهديده بقتل خطيبته وأقاربه حتى يجبره على الزواج من ابنته المريضة بالإيدز، وتتوالى الأحداث.

programme.title: Raya and Sakina / ريا وسكينة
programme.desc: The story of the life of the two sisters (Raya) and (Sakina), which are one of the most famous criminals of the twentieth century in Egypt. The women spared the beginning of the century and were behind the killing of dozens, and the series shows the circumstances that led to the transformation of the two sisters Raya and Sakina into two criminals, reviewing the developments of their lives and their access to those around them, and the impact of the environment in which the two sisters grew up on their future. / قصة حياة الأختين (ريا) و(سكينة)، وهما من أشهر مجرمات القرن العشرين في مصر. روعتا النساء في مطلع القرن وكانتا وراء مقتل العشرات، ويعرض المسلسل الظروف التي أدت إلى تحول الأختين ريا وسكينة إلى مجرمتين مستعرضًا تطورات حياتهما وصلتهما بالمحيطين بهما، وتأثير البيئة التي نشأت فيها الأختان على مستقبلهما.

programme.title: Covenant / العهد
programme.desc: The events take place inside the Damascene neighborhood in two time periods separated by 15 years, during the period before the liberation of Damascus from the Ottoman occupation, and its hegemony period on the neighborhood, where a strong conflict between the elders and notables of the neighborhood is born to respond and resist it. / تدور الأحداث داخل حارة دمشقية في مرحلتين زمنيتين تفصل بينهما 15 سنة، خلال الفترة التي سبقت تحرير دمشق من الاحتلال العثماني، وفترة هيمنته على الحارة، حيث يولد نزاع قوي بين وجهاء وأعيان الحارة للرد عليه ومقاومته.

programme.title: Unknown heroes / Neznámí hrdinove
programme.desc: Imrich Gablech was one of MS. Airmen who took advantage of training in the First Republic army and joined the fighting on fronts of the 2nd World War. He fought in Poland and later worked in England. In the 1950s, the Communist regime rewarded him with persecution. He was not recognized until November 1989. / Imrich Gablech byl jedním z čs. letců, kteří využili výcviku v prvorepublikove armádě a zapojili se do bojů na frontách 2. světove války. Bojoval v Polsku a později působil v Anglii. Komunistický režim se mu v padesátých letech odměnil perzekucí. Uznání se dočkal až po listopadu 1989.

programme.title: Trips to Agde or the war of bidons / Cesty do Agde aneb Válka bidonů
programme.desc: Male town on the south coast of France was the most important place for the Czechoslovak army abroad in 1939–1940. Nobody knew that the scope of our volunteers in the former internment camp for Spanish interbrigadists would leave so many traces even in the third millennium. He appeared the scroll of Amaterske's film, which began to unfold the story of determination, disappointment, heroic victims and cowardice. A total of 8169 Czechoslovaks came to Agde. The testimonies of living participants are very surprising in places. We will see the places where our units with only five rifles were deployed. The artillery could not have been sent to the fighting at all, because it had nothing to pull - there were no horses, there were no cars. The departure from France was then for our units. It was a miracle for soldiers when they got a uniform in England, a dining set without bidon, soap and even mercenary. It was a strange war. For our warriors, the war of confusion and escapes. The documentary filmmakers managed to find ... / Male městečko na jižním pobřeží Francie bylo v letech 1939–1940 nejdůležitějším místem pro tvořící se československou armádu v zahraničí. Nikdo netušil, že působnost našich dobrovolníků v bývalem internačním táboře pro španělske interbrigadisty zanechá tolik stop i ve třetím tisíciletí. Objevil se svitek amaterskeho filmu, který začal odvíjet příběh odhodlání, zklamání, hrdinských obětí i zbabělosti. Do Agde přijelo celkem 8169 Čechoslováků. Výpovědi doposud žijících účastníků jsou místy velmi překvapive. Uvidíme místa, kde byly nasazeny naše jednotky s pouhými pěti náboji pro pušku. Dělostřelectvo nemohlo být vůbec do bojů vysláno, jelikož nemělo děla čím tahat – nebyli k dispozici koně, nebyla ani auta. Odjezd z Francie byl pak pro naše jednotky vysvobozením. Jako zázrak na vojáky působilo, když v Anglii dostali uniformu, jídelní soupravu bez bidonu, mýdlo a dokonce i žold. Byla to zvláštní válka. Pro naše bojovníky spíše válka zmatku a útěků. Dokumentaristům se podařilo najít...

programme.title: Traces, facts, mystery / Stopy, fakta, tajemství
programme.desc: Perhaps little was enough and the first Czechoslovak president could die during the assassination. It was 1921 and Tomáš Garrigue Masaryk was about to go to Moravia, Slovakia and Subcarpathian Ruthenia. It is in Slovakia, near Carpathian Ruthenia, but a group of armed and all capable assassins awaited him. Why did President Masaryk survive and why did not eventually occur? This is discovered by a recently discovered and unique document that should never have been in public. After ninety years, however, it was acquired by Stanislav Motl, who set out to search for all possible circumstances concerning the planned grenade attack on President Masaryk. / Možná stačilo málo a první československý prezident mohl zahynout při atentátu. Psal se rok 1921 a Tomáš Garrigue Masaryk se chystal na svou velkou cestu na Moravu, Slovensko a Podkarpatskou Rus. Právě na Slovensku, už nedaleko Podkarpatske Rusi, na něho ale čekala skupina ozbrojených a všeho schopných atentátníků. Proč prezident Masaryk přežil a proč k atentátu nakonec nedošlo? O tom hovoří nedávno objevený a veskrze unikátní dokument, který se nikdy neměl dostat na veřejnost. Po devadesáti letech ho však získal Stanislav Motl, který se vydal pátrat po všech možných okolnostech, ktere se týkaly chystaneho granátoveho útoku na prezidenta Masaryka.

programme.title: Don't get / Nedej se
programme.desc: Ethology, ie the behavior and experience of animals, has a strong and long tradition in our country, especially thanks to the research of the Institute of Animal Production in Prague and the local department of ethology. In behavioral experiments, scientists deal with questions that one does not normally ask for animals. How do farm animals experience boredom? What causes their stress? And how do they feel pain? / Etologie, tedy chování a prožívání zvířat, má u nás silnou a dlouhou tradici zvláště díky Výzkumnemu ústavu živočišne výroby v Praze a tamějšímu oddělení etologie. V behaviorálních experimentech se tam vědci zabývají otázkami, ktere si v souvislosti se zvířaty člověk běžně neklade. Jakým způsobem hospodářsky chovaná zvířata prožívají nudu? Co způsobuje jejich stres? A jak cítí bolest?

programme.title: Our countryside / Náš venkov
programme.desc: The woodcarver Jiří Halouzka "inherited" his craft after his great -grandfather and grandfather. He lives with his family in the village of Jiříkov in the Bruntál region, where he has his huge great -grandfather gallery with many statues of life and life -size. Halouzka enjoys in these large statues, even if they give him much more work, consumes more wood, more must take care of the details of the sculptures that are much more visible. But he makes larger sculptures more pleased with his viewers. programme.title: Summer language / Sommergesprache
programme.desc: E04 head of domestic politics Klaus Webhofer for the first time through the interview series. The "Summer Talks 25" with the chairpersons of the parliament represented in the parliament can be seen this year from August 11th to September 8th, every Monday, at 9:00 p.m. in ORF 2 and on ORF ON. The setting for the first time since 2022 is the ORF media campus on Kuniglberg. After the long phase of government formation, Austria looks at a connected domestic landscape. Schauplatz ist erstmals seit 2022 wieder der ORF-Mediencampus am Kuniglberg. Nach der langen Phase der Regierungsbildung blickt Österreich auf eine veranderte innenpolitische Landschaft. An den Spitzen der Parlamentsparteien hat es zum Teil uberraschende Personal- und Rollenwechsel gegeben. Christian Stocker ist vom ÖVP-Generalsekretar zum Bundesparteiobmann und Bundeskanzler aufgestiegen. Nun stellt er sich seinem ersten ORF-Sommergesprach. Wie erlebt er personlich den Wechsel vom Parteimanager zum Chef der Dreier-Koalition? programme.title: Al Pacino - From Underdog to the film legend / Al Pacino - Vom Underdog zur Filmlegende
programme.desc: He is considered the acting giant, one of the most splendid Hollywood stars of the 20th century. Awarded with an Oscar, two Tony and two prime time Emmy Awards, he is a living legend: Al Pacino - on April 25, 2025, he will be 85 years old. In his roles, Pacino has created the hidden worlds of the Italian mafia, those of gay rights activists or gangsters and figures that remain unforgettable: from Michael Corleone in "Der Spate" to Tony Montana in "Scarface" or the title -giving "Serpico". Director Jean-Baptiste Peritie traces the path of an outsider who bought the top but threatened to lose himself on the way. The documentary describes how the Italo-American from the New York Bronx was tormented by fears, inner damons and his alcohol addiction, but was finally able to unpaper with his overworming success. / Er gilt als Schauspiel-Gigant, als einer der pragendsten Hollywood-Stars des 20. Jahrhunderts. Ausgezeichnet mit einem Oscar, zwei Tonys und zwei Primetime Emmy Awards, ist er langst eine lebende Legende: Al Pacino - am 25. April 2025 wird er 85 Jahre alt. In seinen Rollen hat Pacino die verborgenen Welten der italienischen Mafia, jene von Schwulenrechtsaktivisten oder Gangstern durchforstet und Figuren geschaffen, die unvergesslich bleiben: von Michael Corleone in "Der Pate" bis zu Tony Montana in "Scarface" oder den titelgebenden "Serpico". Regisseur Jean-Baptiste Peritie zeichnet den Weg eines Outsider nach, der sich ganz nach oben kampfte, doch auf dem Weg dorthin sich zu verlieren drohte. Die Doku schildert, wie der Italo-Amerikaner aus der New Yorker Bronx von Ängsten, inneren Damonen und seiner Alkohol-Sucht gepeinigt wurde, sich aber schlieSSlich mit seinem uberwaltigenden Erfolg aussohnen konnte.

programme.title: Snake / Serpico
programme.desc: Gripping cop thriller for true events. Al Pacino has been nominated for the role of the unconnected New York Cops Frank Serpico for the Oscar. With long hair and hippie outfit, he has little love with his colleagues. When he discovered that the police collect lubricating money from the gangsters and refuses to accept bribes, he is offset. Serpico undeterred to fight the corrupt system and gives rise to death. / Packender Cop-Thriller nach wahren Begebenheiten. Al Pacino ist fur die Rolle des unkonvetionellen New Yorker Cops Frank Serpico fur den Oscar nominiert worden. Spannend inszeniert von Meisterregisseur Sydney Lumet. Der junge, idealistische Cop Frank Serpico tritt seinen Dienst bei der New Yorker Polizei an. Mit langen Haaren und Hippie-Outfit stoSSt er bei den Kollegen auf wenig Gegenliebe. programme.title: Tyrolean Bauernhauser - between romance and reality / Tiroler Bauernhauser - Zwischen Romantik und Realitat
programme.desc: "As soon as the flies revolve around the soup, the romanticism at the farm catches up," says Tyrolean farmer and actor Tobias Moretti. With his wife Julia, he manages an old farm near Innsbruck. "We voluntarily bought hard work," says the passionate farmer Julia Moretti. 30 years ago, 700 powdery ensembles were preserved in Tyrol, today there are just 80. For this riveting result there is a study carried out by the Tyrolean art cadastre. Julia Moretti is committed to the "Langenfeld explanation" as an ambassador for the "Landliche Baukultur. But what does an active farmer do with an old farm who is a listed building and who is difficult to manage with a modern tractor? Teresa Andreae, the designer of the documentary, visited several historical farmers' farm in North and East Tyrol with her team and shows picture on ... / "Sobald die Fliegen aus dem Stall um die Suppe kreisen, hort sich die Romantik am Bauernhof auf", sagt der Tiroler Bauer und Schauspieler Tobias Moretti. Er bewirtschaftet mit seiner Frau Julia einen alten Hof in der Nahe von Innsbruck. "Wir haben uns freiwillig harte Arbeit gekauft", sagt die leidenschaftliche Bauerin Julia Moretti. Vor 30 Jahren waren in Tirol noch 700 bauerliche Ensembles erhalten, heute sind es gerade noch 80. Zu diesem aufruttelnden Ergebnis kommt eine vom Tiroler Kunstkataster durchgefuhrte Studie. Julia Moretti engagiert sich als Botschafterin fur die "Langenfelder Erklarung", das ist ein Pladoyer fur den Erhalt von landlicher Baukultur. Doch was tut ein aktiver Bauer mit einem alten Hof, der unter Denkmalschutz steht, und der sich mit einem modernen Traktor nur schwer bewirtschaften lasst? Teresa Andreae, die Gestalterin der Dokumentation, hat mit ihrem Team mehrere historische Bauernhofe in Nord- und Osttirol besucht und zeigt im Österreich Bild am...

programme.title: The school of animals - learning from fellow species / Die Schule der Tiere - Lernen von Artgenossen
programme.desc: Not only people cooperate and act in social groups - many animal species have also learned to pass on their knowledge and experience. Whether successful hunting techniques, the search for food, recognizing and warding off dangers, or adaptation of well -preserved hiking routes due to the global warming - every species has developed fascinating methods to ensure their own survival or to learn how to make life easier. For example, the younger generation of earthmen show how scorpions are safely killed, macaks give to other and orcas have recognized that it is more convenient to steal their meal directly from the fisherman's fishing hook. This documentation accompanies animal behavior researchers around the globe, which steadily discovered surprising, highly developed animal societies and cultures. / Nicht nur Menschen kooperieren und agieren in sozialen Gruppen - auch viele Tierarten haben gelernt, ihr Wissen und ihre Erfahrung weiterzugeben. Ob erfolgreiche Jagdtechniken, die Suche nach Nahrung, das Erkennen und Abwehren von Gefahren, oder die Adaption altbewahrter Wanderrouten aufgrund der globalen Erwarmung - jede Spezies hat faszinierende Methoden entwickelt, um ihr eigenes Überleben zu sichern oder um Artgenossen zu lernen, wie sie sich das Leben erleichtern konnen. So zeigen Erdmannchen der jungeren Generation, wie Skorpione gefahrlos erlegt werden, Makaken geben SuSSkartoffel-Rezepte an andere weiter und Orcas haben erkannt, dass es bequemer ist, ihre Mahlzeit direkt vom Angelhaken der Fischer zu stehlen. Diese Dokumentation begleitet Tierverhaltensforscher rund um den Globus, die standig Überraschendes uber hoch entwickelte tierische Gesellschaften und Kulturen entdecken.

programme.title: To the most extreme - bishop Erwin Krautler / Bis zum ÄuSSersten - Bischof Erwin Krautler
programme.desc: For decades, Bishop Erwin Krautler, who comes from Vorarlberg, campaigned for the rights of indigenous population and against the destruction of the Amazon area. As a bishop of Amazonia/Altamira, he was primarily a thorn in the side. Many employees of the bishop had to pay their commitment with death. And Erwin Krautler himself has already accepted a lot: he was arrested, tortured, threatened with death. Erwin Krautler, who is characterized by the theology of liberation and inevitably gathered for spirituality and politics, mysticism and resistance in 2010 for his commitment with the alternative Nobel Prize. / Jahrzehntelang hat sich der aus Vorarlberg stammende Bischof Erwin Krautler fur die Rechte der indigenen Bevolkerung und gegen die Zerstorung des Amazonasgebiets eingesetzt. Als Bischof von Amazonien/Altamira war er damit vor allem GroSSgrundbesitzern ein Dorn im Auge. Viele Mitarbeitende des Bischofs mussten ihr Engagement mit dem Tod bezahlen. Und auch Erwin Krautler selbst hat schon einiges in Kauf genommen: er wurde verhaftet, gefoltert, mit dem Tod bedroht. Erwin Krautler, der von der Theologie der Befreiung gepragt ist und fur den Spiritualitat und Politik, Mystik und Widerstand unweigerlich zusammengehoren wurde 2010 fur sein Engagement mit dem Alternativen Nobelpreis ausgezeichnet.

programme.title: On the trail of the Lowen / Auf der Spur des Lowen
programme.desc: In order to stand up to her incurable sick brother Frederick, the shy people of Eleonore forces itself to a trip to the distance of Sudafrika, where she has to stand up for her overhauling fear. Jutta Speidel shines alongside Michael Mendl, Hary Prinz and Nicole Beutler. In itself, Eleonore Kramer leads a regulated life, but spends most of the time in their four wandes. What is afraid of Eleonore is human contact - very different from her beloved brother Frederick, who is acting as a missionary in a Sudafrican children's home. When Eleonore learns that Frederick is terminally ill and has no longer life, she overflows her fear of human close and forces herself to climb an airplane towards Sudafrika. Max, a friend of Frederick, accompanies her. Eleonore still has no idea that this trip will be her life from scratch. / Um ihrem unheilbar kranken Bruder Frederick beizustehen, zwingt sich die menschenscheue Eleonore zu einer Reise ins ferne Sudafrika, wo sie sich notgedrungen ihrer ubermachtigen Angst vor Nahe stellen muss. An sich fuhrt Eleonore Kramer ein geregeltes Leben, verbringt die meiste Zeit jedoch zuruckgezogen in ihren vier Wanden. Was Eleonore scheut, ist menschlicher Kontakt - ganz anders als ihr geliebter Bruder Frederick, der als Missionar in einem sudafrikanischen Kinderheim tatig ist. Als Eleonore erfahrt, dass Frederick todkrank ist und nicht mehr lange zu leben hat, uberwindet sie ihre Angst vor menschlicher Nahe und zwingt sich, ein Flugzeug Richtung Sudafrika zu besteigen. Max, ein Freund Fredericks, begleitet sie. Noch ahnt Eleonore nicht, dass diese Reise ihr Leben von Grund auf andern wird.

programme.title: Ants - the secret world power / Ameisen - Die heimliche Weltmacht
programme.desc: Ants are a secret world power on our planet. All ant types are taken together, their mass risks that of all of humanity. They are as native to coughs as in the polar regions, and how we humans live ants in social states, drove wars and hold slaves. For this documentary, Wolfgang Thaler, who has been awarded the fuels of various anthone types, takes on a magnifying glass for his camera work in the documentaries "Assam - in the Land of Beebow" and "Bees - a life for the Konigin" several times with international prices. A documentary by Wolfgang Thaler with the support of the Federal Ministry for Education, Science and Culture / Ameisen sind eine heimliche Weltmacht auf unserem Planeten. Alle Ameisenarten zusammengenommen ubersteigt ihre Masse die der gesamten Menschheit. Sie sind in Wusten ebenso heimisch wie in den Polarregionen, und wie wir Menschen leben Ameisen in sozialen Staaten, fuhren Kriege und halten Sklaven. Fur diese Dokumentation nimmt Wolfgang Thaler, der fur seine Kameraarbeit bei den Dokumentationen "Assam - Im Land der Bienenbaume" und "Bienen - Ein Leben fur die Konigin" mehrfach mit internationalen Preisen ausgezeichnet wurde, gemeinsam mit den fuhrenden Ameisenforschern der Welt Biologie und Verhaltensweisen verschiedenster Ameisenarten unter die Lupe. Eine Dokumentation von Wolfgang Thaler Mit Unterstutzung des Bundesministeriums fur Bildung, Wissenschaft und Kultur

programme.title: Locksmith, lakes and high mountains / Schlosser, Seen und hohe Berge
programme.desc: Kuhn built, on a rock nose in the tranquil Allgau, the stone dream of Ludwig II - the Neuschwanstein Castle. Between illusionist wall paintings, gold -based fabrics and all sorts of objects, each one of which represents a real gem, the lock is decorated by different leitmotifs: the swan as a heraldic animal and Christian symbol of purity can be found in many corners and angles. Although the Marchenwelt Neuschwanstein was probably able to enchant its visitors for days with their pomp and splendor, the trip continues; Passing the Plansee, which acts like a matt grun mirror for the summit over the bogged summit, to the goal: the Wilde Karwendelgebirge. More than 340 sources arise from the local landscape there - including the Isar, which is probably known to many as a Bavarian, although their origin is in Tyrol. In this ORF-III new production, the filmmaker Hans Jochler passes through the ... / Kuhn errichtet, auf einer Felsnase im beschaulichen Allgau steht der Stein gewordene Traum Konig Ludwigs II. - das Schloss Neuschwanstein. Zwischen illusionistischen Wandmalereien, golddurchwirkten Stoffen und allerlei Gegenstanden, von denen jeder Einzelne ein wahres Kleinod darstellt, wird das Schloss von verschiedenen Leitmotiven verziert: So ist der Schwan als Wappentier und christliches Symbol der Reinheit in vielen Ecken und Winkeln wiederzufinden. Obgleich die Marchenwelt Neuschwansteins ihre BesucherInnen wohl auch tagelang mit ihrem Pomp und Prunk bezaubern konnte, fuhrt die Reise weiter; vorbei am Plansee, der wie ein mattgruner Spiegel fur die ihn umsaumenden Gipfel wirkt, bis zum Ziel: das wilde Karwendelgebirge. Mehr als 340 Quellen entspringen der dortigen, urtumlichen Landschaft - so auch die Isar, die vielen wohl eher als Bayerin bekannt ist, obgleich ihr Ursprung in Tirol liegt. programme.title: From the steppe to the Alps - bird in Austria / Von der Steppe in die Alpen - Vogel in Österreich
programme.desc: Austria's bird world is extremely diverse. Vogel core practically all habitats - from the gentle Puszta in the east of the country to the rugged mountain slope of the Alpine Republic. * The cinematic journey begins in Burgenland, where the gray ganse begins with the breeding wing in February. Kiebitzen and other migratory birds soon return to Seewinkel. Only when the snow has melted in the mountains of Karnten, the courtship of the alpine bird begins. * More than 300 species of birds can be observed in Austria during the year. There are particularly many of their best in the spring. For the ornithologist Leander Khil, the breeding season is the most colorful and cheap time in the bird year. Everything balances, sings and cleans. Many species occur in the area of ​​Lake Neusiedler. The pale ganse has overwintered here. They move back into their Siberian breeding areas in the late winter. Different the gray ganse based here: Many couples are already their whole life ... / Österreichs Vogelwelt ist ausgesprochen vielfaltig. Vogel bevolkern praktisch alle Lebensraume - von der sanften Puszta im Osten des Landes bis auf die schroffen Berghange der Alpenrepublik. * Die filmische Reise beginnt im Burgenland, wo die Grauganse schon im Februar mit dem Brutgeschaft beginnen. Bald kehren auch Kiebitze und andere Zugvogel in den Seewinkel zuruck. Erst wenn der Schnee in den Bergen Karntens geschmolzen ist, beginnt die Balz der Alpenvogel. * Mehr als 300 Vogelarten konnen im Jahreslauf in Österreich beobachtet werden. Im Fruhling zeigen sich besonders viele von ihrer besten Seite. Fur den Ornithologen Leander Khil ist die Brutzeit die bunteste und schonste Zeit im Vogeljahr. Alles balzt, singt und putzt sich heraus. Besonders viele Arten kommen im Gebiet des Neusiedler Sees vor. Die Blassganse haben hier uberwintert. Sie ziehen im Spatwinter zuruck in ihre sibirischen Brutgebiete. Anders die hier ansassigen Grauganse: Viele Paare sind schon ihr ganzes Leben...

programme.title: The owl's flight / Der Flug der Eule
programme.desc: The story of a young barn female, which loses his habitat through adverse circumstances and is looking for a new place again, forms the framework of the film. In search of a place to stay, it meets more European owl species over a year, each of which tells their own history. In the end, the youngsters stands as a hope for all owl species whose existence depends on us humans. In this film, both the biological background of the owl species and a broad overview of their habitats and customs are to be given. A female barn loses your home after a house was demolished. Now it is forced to find a new area. Istvan Nadaskay documented this adventurous search for a year and shows the marriages of this interesting bird. Denn den Überblick hat sie bei dem gehorteten Trodel langst verloren und Marco mochte mit dem Trodel nichts zu tun haben. Weil er nicht weiter weiSS, schickt er einen Hilferuf an den Trodeltrupp.

programme.title: The trodent team - the money is in the basement / Der Trodeltrupp - Das Geld liegt im Keller
programme.sub-title: Entweder die Sachen verschwinden endlich oder ich trenne mich!
programme.desc: E196? Either things finally disappear or I separate! The parchen has been married for six years, but her relationship is put to the test by Kais. / E196 ?Entweder die Sachen verschwinden endlich oder ich trenne mich!?, so lautet das Ultimatum, das Bianca ihrem Kai stellt. Das Parchen ist seit sechs Jahren verheiratet, doch ihre Beziehung wird durch Kais Sammelwut auf eine Probe gestellt.

programme.title: The trodent team - the money is in the basement / Der Trodeltrupp - Das Geld liegt im Keller
programme.desc: E373 Betina (42) is close to the trannies as soon as she enters the apartment of her late mother Irene. When she died a few months ago, she left her daughter her parents' house - but also owe 130,000 euros. This is exactly what Betina lets despair, because how should she raise the money? After all, she has three children and has to keep her own family over water. In addition, it is incredibly difficult for the 42-year-old to eliminate her mother's household, because Betina has far from cope with the death of Irene. That is why the Andreas Bierschock family from RTL II-Trodeltrupp calls. He is intended to help make a large part of the household person in money so that Betina can pay part of the debts. The mother of three also suspects some treasures in trodelchaos. Can RTL II sales expert Andi find the precious treasure so that the family can take a deep breath? / E373 Betina (42) ist den Tranen nahe, sobald sie die Wohnung ihrer verstorbenen Mutter Irene betritt. Als sie vor einigen Monaten verstarb, hat sie ihrer Tochter das Elternhaus hinterlassen - allerdings auch 130.000 Euro Schulden. Genau das lasst Betina verzweifeln, denn wie soll sie das Geld nur aufbringen? SchlieSSlich hat sie drei Kinder und muss ihre eigene Familie uber Wasser halten. AuSSerdem fallt es der 42-Jahrigen unglaublich schwer, den Haushalt ihrer Mutter aufzulosen, denn den Tod von Irene hat Betina noch lange nicht verkraftet. Deswegen ruft die Familie Andreas Bierschock vom RTL II-Trodeltrupp. Er soll dabei helfen, einen GroSSteil des Hausrates zu Geld zu machen, damit Betina einen Teil der Schulden abbezahlen kann. Die dreifache Mutter vermutet auSSerdem noch einige Schatze im Trodelchaos. Kann RTL II-Verkaufsexperte Andi die kostbaren Schatze finden, damit die Familie finanziell wieder durchatmen kann?

programme.title: The trodent team - the money is in the basement / Der Trodeltrupp - Das Geld liegt im Keller
programme.desc: E462 for Andreas (46) are the 70s and 80s far more than darkest past. The musician loves everything that dates from the two decades and has accumulated a lot over the years: Impensant hi-fi Gerats, keyboards, designer furniture, a jukebox and studio electronics adorn the family's basement. However, wife Denise (45) can only start with her husband's hobby. The host wants to put an end to the whole and put out the basement and the garage. A wellness oasis is to be created there. Due to Andreas walking disabilities, Denise and the shared son Alexander (14) are on his own. Therefore, the RTL II trodent is supposed to help transform her husband's treasures into cash. An unusual case for sales profi Otto Schulte, after all, he doesn't have to bring such extraordinary things to the man every day. He is amazed when he examines Andreas Trodel for the first time. / E462 Fur Andreas (46) sind die 70er- und 80er-Jahre weit mehr als dunkelste Vergangenheit. Der Musiker liebt alles, was aus den beiden Jahrzehnten stammt und hat uber Jahre hinweg einiges angesammelt: Unzahlige HiFi-Gerate, Keyboards, Designermobel, eine Jukebox und Studioelektronik zieren die Kellerraume der Familie. Ehefrau Denise (45) kann allerdings nur wenig mit dem Hobby ihres Mannes anfangen. Die Hausherrin will dem Ganzen ein Ende setzen und den Keller und die Garage ausraumen. Dort soll eine Wellness-Oase entstehen. Aufgrund von Andreas Gehbehinderung sind Denise und der gemeinsame Sohn Alexander (14) auf sich allein gestellt. Deshalb soll der RTL II-Trodeltrupp dabei helfen, die Schatze ihres Mannes in Bares zu verwandeln. Ein ungewohnlicher Fall fur Verkaufsprofi Otto Schulte, schlieSSlich muss er nicht jeden Tag solch auSSergewohnliche Sachen an den Mann bringen. Er staunt nicht schlecht, als er Andreas Trodel das erste Mal begutachtet.

programme.title: The Schnappchenhauser - the dream of your own home / Die Schnappchenhauser - Der Traum vom Eigenheim
programme.sub-title: Ein alter Supermarkt als neues Zuhause
programme.desc: E88 Since Stefanie and Dennis cannot afford to buy a house, rent the house for 910 euros warm rent - a real snap for this space. However, there is still a lot to do in the house. Eight wands are to be collected so that a large residential cake, a bathroom and four rooms can be created. In addition, there is the damage of the roof, new floor, tiles, three toilets and a wall breakthrough. Until it is finally homely on the lower floor, the extended family lives temporarily on the upper floor - with cables and down -the -fold wallpapers. Dennis makes the manual work alone. The trained carpenter has been able to use various construction sites for years. A strenuous time begins for Dennis and Stefanie, because their eight children also want to be henged during the renovation work. / E88 Da sich Stefanie und Dennis keinen Hauskauf leisten konnen, mieten sie das Haus fur 910 Euro Warmmiete - ein echtes Schnappchen fur dieses Platzangebot. Allerdings ist in dem Haus noch jede Menge zu tun. Es sollen acht Wande eingezogen werden, damit eine groSSe Wohnkuche, ein Bad und vier Zimmer entstehen konnen. Hinzu kommt die Dammung des Daches, neue FuSSboden, Fliesen, drei Toiletten und ein Wanddurchbruch. Bis es in der unteren Etage endlich wohnlich ist, lebt die GroSSfamilie provisorisch in der oberen Etage - mit notdurftig verlegten Kabeln und herunterhangenden Tapeten. Die handwerklichen Arbeiten macht Dennis zum GroSSteil alleine. Das Konnen hat sich der gelernte Tischler jahrelang auf diversen Baustellen angeeignet. Fur Dennis und Stefanie beginnt eine anstrengende Zeit, denn auch wahrend der Sanierungsarbeiten wollen ihre acht Kinder beschaftigt werden.

programme.title: Football (M): Hajduk S. - Rijeka, Croatian League 2025/26 / Nogomet (M): Hajduk S. - Rijeka, Hrvaška liga 2025/26
